Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ziengs over de berichten ‘Taxirijden op Schiphol, in ruil voor een envelop vol cash’ en ‘SchipholTaxi verliest kort geding tegen NRC’

MP Ziengs asked the ministers whether they knew of and found worrying press reports that Schiphol taxi drivers were pressured to pay cash for concessions, whether earlier complaints were handled, and whether investigation and safeguards against conflicts of interest are adequate. The ministers answered that Schiphol, as the responsible company, started its own investigation including the concession award, found no irregularities, and that the Marechaussee and Openbaar Ministerie are considering further steps.
In consultation with the Openbaar Ministerie Noord-Holland, the Koninklijke Marechaussee is considering whether a preliminary investigation should be started based on the new information.
In overleg met het Openbaar Ministerie Noord-Holland bekijkt de Koninklijke Marechaussee of er op basis van de nieuwe informatie een oriënterend onderzoek gestart dient te worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ziengs over het bericht 'Over de Maas is transparant, maar alleen tot op zekere hoogte'

An MP asks the minister about the soil imported for the 'Over de Maas' project, including inspection results, the planned municipal investigation, and whether the goals of shallowing deep lakes are defined. The minister replies that imported soil must meet legal standards, that inspections found poor compliance and were intensified for 2019-2020, and that the project goals are set in advance and tendering considers more than price.
It was established that compliance with the regulations was poor.
Hierbij is vastgesteld dat de naleving op de regelgeving slecht was.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs en Amhaouch over het bericht ‘Subsidie nachttrein verstoort de markt’

MPs Ziengs and Amhaouch asked why a 6.7 million euro subsidy for ÖBB NightJet via NS would not distort the market, whether it is non-discriminatory, a bridging subsidy, and why no lower-cost alternatives were sought. The minister defends a two-track approach: a temporary subsidy to NS/ÖBB for a trial from 2021 while open-access operators are engaged, with compensation capped at net financial effect and limited to the PSO framework.

To reintroduce the night train quickly, a two-track approach was chosen with temporary subsidy to NS alone, while at the same time work proceeds with other interested parties on a non-discriminatory arrangement.

Om de nachttrein op korte termijn al te herintroduceren is gekozen voor een tweeledige aanpak met een tijdelijke subsidiering van alleen NS, terwijl tegelijkertijd met andere geïnteresseerde partijen gewerkt wordt aan een non-discriminatoire regeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Ziengs over ontploffingsgevaar emissiearme stalvloeren en ruimte voor alternatieve systemen

MPs Lodders and Ziengs asked about explosion risk from low-emission stable floors after the Markelo incident, the delayed release of the Omgevingsdienst Twente report, and barriers for innovative systems under the RAV protocol. The government admitted the report was promised but not sent, said a new study on floor safety will be commissioned, and outlined steps to speed up approval procedures.
That was not right, because that had been promised.
Dat was niet goed, want dat was wel beloofd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Ziengs over emissiearme stalvloeren

Two VVD MPs asked whether emission-reducing stable floors have been adequately tested for safety after explosions on dairy farms in Lettele and Markelo, and why earlier warnings and the Technical Advisory Pool's role were not considered. The minister acknowledges the earlier answers should have weighed a 2016 fire-academy warning, and announces a joint study with the Minister for Environment and Housing on the safety of emission-reducing floors, with results to Parliament in early 2020.

Given the remaining questions about the safety of emission-reducing floors for livestock farmers and others involved, the Minister for Environment and Housing and I will commission a study into the safety of emission-reducing floors in practical use.

Gezien de vragen die resteren over de veiligheid van emissiearme vloeren bij veehouders en andere betrokkenen zullen de Minister voor Milieu en Wonen en ik een onderzoek laten uitvoeren naar de veiligheid van emissiearme vloeren bij het gebruik in de praktijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Ziengs over het bericht 'Massale muizen- en rattenplaag op komst in Nederland'

MPs Weverling and Ziengs asked the ministers about reports of a looming mouse and rat plague, criticism from the KAD that government is complacent, the planned restriction of anticoagulant rodenticides from 2023, and whether adequate alternatives and ongoing research exist. The state secretary answers that integrated pest management and prevention are central, that a RIVM exploratory study is underway with its report expected end 2019, and that alternatives remain available, while the Ctgb is planning to limit anticoagulants to certified professionals.
The cabinet wants to reduce the number of barn fires in line with the reaction agreement.
Het kabinet wil conform het reageerakkoord het aantal stalbranden verminderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ziengs over het bericht 'Forse rookontwikkeling bij brand afvalverwerker Attero in Wijster'

An MP asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about a fire at waste processor Attero in Wijster, the amount and quality of collected waste, how long waste may be stored, whether processors can refuse waste, who is responsible for waste quality, and how the focus can shift from quantity to quality. The State Secretary answered with five-year tonnage tables, described the acceptance and processing policy framework and storage limits, and pointed to ongoing quality programmes and planned producer responsibility extensions.
I am working on this with stakeholders, within the VANG-HHA implementation programme through the 'action plan for green waste and textiles'.
Ik werk hier samen met stakeholders aan, binnen het Uitvoeringsprogramma VANG-HHA middels het «aanvalsplan gft-afval en textiel».
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wiersma, Laan-Geselschap, Ziengs en Nijkerken-De Haan over de berichtgeving over gezichtsbedekkende kleding in het openbaar vervoer

VVD MPs asked the government whether it supports a bus driver who refused to continue with a niqab-wearing passenger, whether the face-covering ban is being applied consistently in public transport, hospitals and other institutions, and what steps will be taken to clarify enforcement with police and operators. The minister answered that operators and staff should first ask the person to remove the covering or leave, that police should be called if needed, that the practice is being clarified with sector bodies, and that the government will keep monitoring implementation.

The cabinet supports compliance with the law by institutions, paying attention to how the procedure is designed so that it takes account of safeguarding a safe public task and the roles that employer and employee have in compliance with this law.

Het kabinet ondersteunt de naleving van de wet door de instellingen, met aandacht voor de invulling van de werkwijze die rekening houdt met het zorgen voor een veilige publieke taak en de rol die de werkgever en werknemer bij deze wet met betrekking tot de naleving hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ziengs over het bericht 'Risico voor NS met grote bestelling van treinmaterieel HSL'

An MP asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management whether NS's large order of ICNG trains for the Amsterdam-Brussels line (IC Brussel) is premature and risks prejudging the HSL tender decision, and what happens to the trains if another operator wins. The State Secretary answered that the trains are covered by the Redelijke Regeling, so NS bears no investment risk, that the decision does not prejudge the 2020 market-ordering decision, and that options for the HSL will be assessed before a decision in spring 2020.
As previously shared with your House, NS is not anticipating the market-ordering decision that I will take next spring with the ordering of ICNG-B trains for the IC Brussel.
Antwoord 3 Zoals eerder met uw Kamer gedeeld 3 loopt NS met de bestelling van ICNG-B-treinen voor de IC Brussel niet vooruit op het ordeningsbesluit dat ik volgend voorjaar neem.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs, Weverling en Remco Dijkstra over het bericht “onverwoestbaar stofje gaat bouwprojecten lamleggen” en over de gevolgen van de industriële stof PFOS voor de bouwwereld

Three VVD MPs asked the state secretary whether new PFAS rules for soil and dredged material would further delay road and housing projects, and how the government would address the concerns of municipalities and industry. The state secretary replied that the temporary framework adds clarity rather than new obligations, that the duty of care applies where PFAS is found, that she is consulting with regional authorities and will inform the House in early 2020.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ziengs over het bericht ‘Extra spitstrein op Maaslijn, Boxmeer verliest aansluiting’

An MP asked about the removal of an extra peak-hour train on the Maaslijn between Boxmeer and Nijmegen, which students and pupils use, and about ridership, delays and alternatives. The State Secretary answered that only about 11 people use the train daily, that the 8.00 train offers an alternative, that delays are a concern, and that electrification and improvement measures are planned to finish by 2024.
According to data from Limburg and Arriva, an average of 11 passengers use the extra peak train daily.
Volgens de gegevens van Limburg en Arriva maken dagelijks gemiddeld 11 reizigers gebruik van de extra spitstrein.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra, Ziengs en Aukje de Vries over het bericht 'Nieuwe’ geul klaar maar werkt nog niet’

MPs asked about the newly dredged Vloedgeul channel on the Holwerd-Ameland ferry route, which was finished but still showed delays, asking about expected travel-time gains, monitoring, further measures and a second cut-off. The minister answered that the expected saving is 4 to 6 minutes but cannot yet be verified, that weekly soundings and a planned measurement campaign will monitor the channel, that quarterly punctuality data will be provided and reviewed in the 2020 transport plan, and that a second bend cut-off and a long-term vision are in preparation.
The information requested by your House is not available in time for the General Consultation on the Wadden of 26 June 2019.
De door uw Kamer gevraagde informatie is niet tijdig beschikbaar voor het Algemeen Overleg Wadden van 26 juni 2019.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Ziengs over het bericht ‘Familie in rouw na drama in stal: dertien koeien komen om in eigen mest na explosie’

MPs Lodders and Ziengs asked the minister about a barn explosion in Markelo that killed thirteen cows, whether investigations were ordered, and whether emission-free floors and new stall systems are assessed for safety. The minister answered that no direct ignition cause was found by the fire service and insurer, that an Omgevingsdienst Twente investigation is pending and will be shared, and that safety is part of stall assessment though no evidence shows emission-free floors are unsafe.
The investigation by the Omgevingsdienst Twente is expected to become publicly available. I will send this to you as soon as it is completed.
Het onderzoek van de Omgevingsdienst Twente zal naar verwachting openbaar beschikbaar komen. Dit zal ik u toezenden zodra dit gereed is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Von Martels en Ziengs over de communicatie door het RIVM omtrent het onderzoeksrapport gewasbescherming en gezondheid

Two MPs asked why the RIVM's report on pesticide exposure among residents was leaked to media and published prematurely, and how the RIVM communicates with other government bodies. The minister regretted the early publications, said the RIVM was addressed on both incidents, and declined to direct the RIVM's communication, saying it has its own legal independence.
I may not direct them in that regard and I do not want to either.
Ik mag daar niet op sturen en wil dat ook niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Ziengs over het Amsterdamse parkeervergunningenbeleid

VVD MPs Dijkstra and Ziengs asked why Amsterdam's parking permit policy excludes older vehicles such as classic cars, whether an emissions-class (RDW) system would be fairer, whether municipalities may regulate this, which Amsterdam streets still exceed the air quality norm, and what legal change would be needed. The State Secretary answered that municipalities set parking policy within the Gemeentewet, that Amsterdam chose registration-date cut-offs pending RDW emissions-class registration, that municipal autonomy permits such rules, that NO2 exceedances remained on several named streets in 2017, and that changing the Wegenverkeerswet was not appropriate.
Municipalities determine their parking permit policy within the framework of the Municipalities Act.
Gemeenten bepalen binnen de kaders van de Gemeentewet hun beleid ten aanzien van parkeervergunningen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Lange, Ziengs en Arno Rutte over automatische externe defibrillators (AED’s) in treinen en op stations

MPs De Lange, Ziengs and Rutte asked whether AEDs should be installed in trains and at all stations, whether theft or vandalism justifies not placing them, and whether tender conditions could require them. The State Secretary answered that NS and ProRail are talking with the Hartstichting about 24/7 access at the 50 largest stations, that operators decide their own first-aid mix, and that a rail concession provision on AEDs in trains is under consideration.
I will have NS inform me about the considerations it makes for providing first aid on moving trains.
Ik zal mij door NS laten informeren over de afwegingen die zij maken voor het verlenen van eerste hulp op de rijdende treinen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Ziengs over de rapportage gezamenlijk meetnet gewasbeschermingsmiddelen in het gebied van het Waterschap Drents Overijsselse Delta

Two VVD MPs asked the government about pesticide exceedances at Waterschap Drents Overijsselse Delta, including permethrin and imidacloprid in consumer products, and about the overall pesticide policy approach. The minister answered that consumer use is hard to link directly to exceedances, that policy addresses both professional and non-professional use, and that the government will send further data such as the RIVM sales analysis before the summer recess.
Sales figures for biocide products for consumers are not available at the Ministry of IenW.
De verkoopcijfers van biocideproducten voor consumenten zijn niet voorhanden bij het Ministerie van IenW.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Ziengs en Omtzigt over het verkopen van bespaarde CO2-rechten door autofabrikant Tesla aan Fiat-Chrysler

MPs Lodders, Ziengs and Omtzigt asked whether the EU-permitted pooling of CO2 emission credits between Tesla and Fiat-Chrysler, which may help Fiat-Chrysler avoid EU fines, is acceptable and whether it will persist under the 95 g/km rules, and how much the national EV stimulus would actually reduce EU-wide emissions given possible waterbed effects. The State Secretary answered that pooling has been allowed since 2007, that the pool average must still meet the EU norm, that the government prefers each manufacturer to meet the norm alone, and that the national EV measures yield about 2.4 Mton additional reduction, with the waterbed effect considered small given Netherlands' roughly 3% share of the EU fleet.
The cabinet is not aware of the exact amount involved between certain manufacturers in this arrangement.
Het kabinet is niet op de hoogte van het exacte bedrag dat tussen bepaalde fabrikanten hiermee is gemoeid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Ziengs en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht ‘Planbureau rommelt’

VVD MPs asked the ministers whether the PBL environmental agency's published claims about meat, climate and nitrogen emissions were accurate, and whether policy had been based on flawed PBL data. The government answered that PBL's independence and quality are safeguarded, that the 25-40% reduction concerns agriculture-related emissions only, and that it knows of no cases where policy was based on incorrect PBL data.
In my view, the above sufficiently safeguards independence and quality now and in the future.
Het bovenstaande waarborgt in mijn ogen nu en in de toekomst voldoende de onafhankelijkheid en kwaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ziengs over het bericht ‘Heerhugowaard blij verrast met opstelterrein’

An MP asked the state secretary why the rail siding was moved from Uitgeest to Heerhugowaard, whether a ministerial decision and additional traffic research were involved, and about level-crossing closure times and safety under the PHS programme. The secretary explained that a cost-driven variant study led to dropping Uitgeest, that the crossing-safety impact was reassessed and found not significant, and committed to further traffic research for three municipalities and to resolving the Castricum crossing.
At the request of three municipalities, additional traffic research is now being carried out for the local connecting roads.
Op verzoek van drie gemeenten vindt nu aanvullend verkeersonderzoek plaats voor de lokale aansluitende wegen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs, Dik-Faber, Sienot en Von Martels over het bericht dat de metingen in de Groninger bodem niet kloppen

Four MPs asked the State Secretary of Infrastructure and Water Management how KNMI measurement errors in Groningen went unreported from August 2018 until February 2019, and what will prevent recurrence. The government answered that the KNMI delayed reporting, announced an evaluation, a working group, and an additional SodM audit, while stating the hazard models and damage decisions are not affected.
We regret that the KNMI did not report the identified deviations in a timely manner.
Wij betreuren het dat het KNMI niet tijdig een melding heeft gemaakt van de geconstateerde afwijkingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ziengs over het bericht ‘Kringloopeconomie komt nog niet van de grond’

MP Ziengs asked whether the minister knew of a PBL report saying the circular economy is not taking off, whether PBL commissioned it, and whether PBL could share its top 25 most restrictive regulations. The state secretary answered that PBL started the study on its own initiative, but said PBL cannot provide a top 25 of regulations, pointed to existing programmes and a taskforce reporting later in 2019, and promised a response to the taskforce report before year end.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ziengs over het bericht ‘Te veel gevaarlijke stoffen per trein langs Amersfoort’

MP Ziengs (VVD) asks the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about exceedances of risk ceilings for hazardous-goods trains near Amersfoort, including how the limits were set, enforcement, whether diversions via the Betuweroute works will last until 2023, and consultation with provinces and municipalities. The State Secretary answers largely by referring to a separate letter, says the Betuweroute third-track works and German permitting cause the diversions, that decisions on specific routes are premature, and that decentralised governments are involved through a risk platform and administrative consultation.
For the answers to the above questions, see my letter 'Explanation of exceedances of risk ceilings on the railways and my approach', which has been sent to your House in parallel with these answers.

Zie voor de beantwoording van bovengenoemde vragen mijn brief «Toelichting op overschrijdingen risicoplafonds op het spoor en mijn aanpak» die parallel aan de beantwoording van deze vragen aan uw Kamer is aangeboden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs en Amhaouch over het bericht ‘Meer NS-treinen stranden op hsl’

MPs Ziengs and Amhaouch asked the State Secretary about reports that more NS trains were stranding on the high-speed line due to a software fault introduced in a mid-2018 update. The State Secretary confirmed the increase, attributed it to a software synchronisation fault, described a corrective update completed in January 2019, and said effects on performance indicators and the 2021 outlook would be reported later.
I will inform your House more about this in the spring.
Ik zal uw Kamer dit voorjaar hierover nader informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs en Aartsen over het onderzoek van TNO waaruit blijkt dat asbesthoudende vensterbanken veilig zijn te verwijderen in de laagste risicoklasse

MPs Ziengs and Aartsen asked the state secretary about TNO research suggesting asbestos window sills can be removed under the lowest risk class, the cost implications, and the governance of the SMA-rt instrument managed by Ascert. The state secretary answered that a pilot and a redesign of the instrument are being prepared, while acknowledging ongoing disputes about oversight and Ascert's representativeness.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs en Lodders over de Regeling ammoniak en veehouderij

MPs Ziengs and Lodders asked how innovators outside livestock farming can get new ammonia-reducing stall systems onto the Rav list, and about procedures, cooperation with other countries, TAP composition and the motion on testing barriers. The government explained quick scans, a maximum 20-week assessment, VERA cooperation, and that it is mapping barriers and will inform the Chamber early next year.
I will inform the Chamber early next year about the steps I will take to remove these barriers as much as possible.
Ik zal de Kamer begin volgend jaar informeren over de stappen die ik zal zetten om deze belemmeringen zo veel mogelijk weg te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs en Remco Dijkstra over harmonisatie van milieuzones

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about the growing patchwork of municipal low-emission zones and the need for uniform national rules before 2020, including questions on communication, proportionality and judicial review. The State Secretary agreed harmonisation is desirable, outlined the planned Euro-class system for 2020 and said municipal zones and their traffic decisions remain open to appeal.
The traffic decision underlying the environmental zone is open to objection and appeal.
Het verkeersbesluit dat ten grondslag ligt aan de milieuzone staat immers open voor bezwaar en beroep.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Ziengs over het bericht ‘Bijna 3000 waarschuwingen voor scooters in milieuzone’

Two VVD MPs asked the state secretary about warnings issued to scooter riders entering Amsterdam's environmental zone, including enforcement methods, the age-based cut-off, and where fines go. The state secretary answered that municipalities set zone rules, enforcement uses ANPR cameras and officers, fines go to the CJIB, and no change to Amsterdam's zone for mopeds is planned.
It is up to the municipality of Amsterdam to determine which rules apply to entering the environmental zone.
Het is aan de gemeente Amsterdam om te bepalen welke regels er gelden voor het betreden van de milieuzone.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs en Lodders over de internetconsultatie Regeling tot wijziging van de Regeling ammoniak en veehouderij (Rav) en de Regeling geurhinder en veehouderij (Rgv)

Two VVD MPs asked the state secretary and minister about the internet consultation on amending the ammonia and odour regulations for livestock farming, questioning the WUR study underlying the change, its financial effects, and whether consultation should have waited for pending questions and parliamentary debate. The government answered that combi-scrubbers perform worse than assumed, that the study is statistically robust, that expansion possibilities will be restricted for affected farms, and that no cost-benefit analysis is available; it deferred some questions to a separate reply.
A cost-benefit analysis is not available.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs en Lodders over de Evaluatie geurverwijdering door luchtwassystemen bij stallen

MPs Ziengs and Lodders asked about differences in air-scrubber performance and standards between the Netherlands and Germany, and about the planned adjustment of odour-reduction percentages for combi-scrubbers following a WUR evaluation. The government answered that no EU or Dutch standards exist for scrubbers, that Dutch and German lab measurements differ due to methodology, that combi-scrubbers underperform relative to permit assumptions, and that it will adjust emission factors, while noting the impact on farmers is limited for existing farms.
The study shows that combi-scrubber systems in practice do not deliver the emission reduction assumed in permits.
Het onderzoek toont aan dat de combi-luchtwassystemen in de praktijk niet de emissiereductie geven waar in vergunningen mee wordt gerekend.
Antwoord op van de leden Ziengs en Van der Graaf over de problemen met de Kamperlijn

Two MPs asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about soft-soil problems on the Kampen railway line, which force a speed limit of 100 km/h and threaten the skipping of Zwolle Stadshagen station, and who bears the costs. The State Secretary said an independent investigation is ongoing, that the costs and risks lie contractually with the commissioning third party, and that she has no formal role and is leaving solutions to ProRail and the regional authorities.
I have no formal role but I call on the parties to keep talking with each other about a solution for travellers.
Ik heb geen formele rol maar roep partijen op om met elkaar in gesprek te blijven over een oplossing voor de reizigers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs en Von Martels over het bericht ’Vieze’ auto parkeren fors duurder

MPs Ziengs and Von Martels asked whether a proposal to let municipalities charge higher parking fees for polluting cars would unfairly burden motorists with older cars and modest incomes. The State Secretary answered that the measure is a incentive for zero-emission vehicles, not a penalty, that categories will be fixed in law to prevent misuse, and that the proposal is still being developed with municipalities.
The categorisation will be legally anchored and there is no room for municipalities' own interpretation.
De categorisering wordt juridisch verankerd en daarbij is geen ruimte voor eigen interpretatie door gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Ziengs over de douane controle Eurostar

MPs Kröger and Ziengs asked why preparations for border controls at Dutch stations for a direct Eurostar service to London were not started sooner, what faster bilateral options exist, how much Marechaussee capacity is needed, and why a transfer in Brussels is safer than Dutch controls. The government replied that a Four-Party Treaty and related agreements are being pursued with a target of 2019 and a direct service from the 2020 timetable, with Marechaussee staffing still to be recruited and passengers transferring in Brussels until then.
The Dutch government's aim is to have all international agreements realised by the end of 2019, so that Eurostar can expect to offer a direct Amsterdam-London connection from the 2020 timetable.

De inzet van de Nederlandse overheid is alle internationale afspraken eind 2019 gerealiseerd te hebben, zodat Eurostar naar verwachting vanaf dienstregeling 2020 een directe verbinding van Amsterdam naar Londen kan gaan aanbieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop, Bruins, Ziengs, Van Aalst, Baudet en Von Martels over het gebruik van werkbakken aan hijskranen bij asbestsanering

MPs asked whether the government will allow cranes with work baskets for asbestos roof removal in exceptional cases, given a sector decision system and an Aboma report criticising stricter Dutch rules. The State Secretary said a независимый study will report before summer 2018 and that a decision on any regulatory change will follow, without committing to temporary relief now.
As promised to the House, I will commission an independent study into the problems the asbestos removal contractors describe.
Ik laat, zoals aan uw Kamer is toegezegd, een onafhankelijk onderzoek uitvoeren naar de problematiek die de asbestsaneerders aangeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs en Wörsdorfer over het bericht  ‘Wirwar van gemeentelijke milieuzones groeit: automobilist kan Maastricht straks alleen nog met milieusticker in’

MPs Ziengs and Wörsdorfer asked about the growing patchwork of municipal environmental zones, including Maastricht's sticker system that affects motorists and entrepreneurs. The State Secretary agreed a uniform system is undesirable, deferred the balancing of interests to municipalities, and committed to a meeting with municipalities and the VNG and to uniform signage by 1 January 2020.
I have invited the new municipal executives and the VNG to sit down together on this matter.
Ik heb de nieuwe gemeentebestuurders en de VNG uitgenodigd om hierover om tafel te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs, Nijkerken-de Haan en Bosman over het bericht ‘Voorbereiding op kernramp kan beter’

VVD MPs asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about an OVV report finding that Dutch nuclear-disaster preparedness is largely on paper and little exercised, and about cooperation, iodine tablet distribution and evacuation planning with Belgium and Germany. The State Secretary answered that cooperation is constructive, that joint exercises are a priority (including a planned exercise with Belgium), that iodine rules were harmonised but differ in practice, and that regional safety boards will be consulted on cross-border risks.
The Dutch Safety Board finds in its report that the approach to a possible nuclear crisis is largely set down on paper but has been exercised only to a limited extent.

De Onderzoeksraad voor Veiligheid (OVV) stelt in haar rapport vast dat de aanpak van een eventuele nucleaire crisis goeddeels vastligt op papier maar dat de aanpak slechts in beperkte mate is geoefend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ziengs over de wijzigingen van de prestatie-indicatoren voor NS

An MP asked the state secretary about NS (Dutch railways) changing its key performance indicators for seat availability on the HSL, and whether the change avoided a third strike under the concession. The state secretary answered that the old indicator scores were below the floor value in 2015 and 2016, that 2017 data under the old method were not calculated, and that the new indicator (91.2% floor) was the basis for judgment from 2017 onward, with the official 2017 figures to follow by 1 March 2018.
I assess NS from 2017 on the performance indicator 'seat availability in the HSL peak'.
Ik beoordeel NS vanaf 2017 op de prestatie-indicator «zitplaatskans in de spits HSL».
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ziengs over het bericht ‘Geen OV op Oudejaarsavond’

An MP asked the state secretary whether it is undesirable that public transport largely stops from 20:00 on New Year's Eve, including at Schiphol, and what steps will be taken. The state secretary acknowledges the wish to reconsider the longstanding arrangement, says there is no data on demand, and will raise the issue at the national public transport table with other authorities and operators, promising to report back.
I am therefore willing to explore whether travellers would be helped by public transport during the New Year period.
Ik ben dan ook graag bereid te verkennen of de reizigers geholpen zouden zijn met openbaar vervoer tijdens de jaarwisseling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Ziengs over de toegang tot het handelsregister van de Kamer van Koophandel

MPs Paternotte and Ziengs asked the State Secretary about the abolition of volume discounts for large buyers of Chamber of Commerce register data, its link to a controversial amendment to the Trade Register Act, and the KvK's data strategy. The State Secretary answered that the tariff change is separate from the bill, that the KvK and commercial users have distinct roles, and that the KvK is modernising data access with stakeholder involvement.
The bill amending the Trade Register Act 2007 is separate from the mentioned tariff change.
Het wetsvoorstel tot wijziging van de Handelsregisterwet 2007 staat los van de genoemde tariefwijziging.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Ziengs over het bericht 'Nieuw peilbesluit IJsselmeer negatief voor watersport'

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about a reported negative impact of the new IJsselmeer water-level decision on watersports, including whether the 10 cm lowering is needed for nature or climate goals, the basis for the reported economic losses, compensation, and whether the minister will talk with the sector. The minister answered that the lowering serves water storage and Natura 2000 goals, that the MER found no significant effects requiring compensation, that the economic estimates come from the sector and cannot be verified, and that talks with municipalities and the sector are ongoing with the decision expected around summer 2018.
The cost estimate for possible adverse economic effects on the watersports sector comes from the sector itself and cannot be verified by the ministry.
De kostenraming over mogelijke nadelige economische effecten voor de watersportsector is afkomstig van de sector zelf en is door het ministerie niet te verifiëren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs en Van den Bosch over het bericht “Laat een prachtig huwelijk niet op de klippen lopen”

MPs Ziengs and Van den Bosch asked about the naval shipbuilding cluster's economic importance, the lack of new orders, and whether the Defence Materiel Organisation has enough capacity for several naval projects. The ministers answered that the cluster is important, that a study on its economic value is planned for early 2018, and that investment decisions are for the next cabinet.

Decision-making on new investments, for example investments in naval equipment, and the possible consequences for the personnel capacity of Defence and of the DMO in particular, is for the next cabinet.

Besluitvorming over nieuwe investeringen, bijvoorbeeld investeringen in marinematerieel, en de eventuele gevolgen hiervan voor de personele capaciteit van Defensie en van de DMO in het bijzonder, is aan het volgende kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs en Lodders over het bericht 'Onzichtbare regeldruk van honderden miljoenen euro’s teistert bedrijfsleven'

MPs Ziengs and Lodders asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that policy rules (beleidsregels) by implementing bodies create hidden regulatory burden for business, and whether these burdens are quantified and reduced. The minister answered that policy rules are formally not legislation and cannot add obligations, that the cited cases largely reflect existing law, inspection instructions or business-own costs, and that knotty cases will be addressed through the existing maatwerk approach without coordinating or quantifying policy rules further.
Policy rules are formally not legislation, so they cannot contain additional obligations for citizens, businesses and institutions beyond those already following from the legislation they elaborate.

Beleidsregels zijn formeel geen wetgeving. Ze kunnen dan ook geen aanvullende verplichtingen voor burgers, bedrijven en instellingen bevatten ten opzichte van de verplichtingen die al volgen uit de wetgeving ter uitwerking waarvan de beleidsregels zijn opgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs en Lodders over het bericht “ Duitse minister: nepvlees mag geen schnitzel heten”

MPs Ziengs and Lodders asked whether vegetarian products may use meat-related names such as 'schnitzel' and whether the Netherlands would follow a German proposed ban. The minister answered that such names are not per se misleading if labelling is clear, that the NVWA enforces against consumer deception including online, and that no national ban is planned because consumers have not reported problems.

When meatless products use terms that are (also) customary for meat-containing products, this is not by definition unclear and misleading, provided the labelling is clear about the absence of meat and the use of other ingredients.

Als voor vleesloze producten termen worden gebruikt die (ook) voor vleeshoudende producten gebruikelijk zijn, is dit niet per definitie onduidelijk en misleidend, als de aanduidingen helder zijn over de afwezigheid van vlees en over het gebruik van andere grondstoffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Ziengs over het akkerbouwonderzoek

MPs Lodders and Ziengs asked why the Rijksdienst voor Ondernemend Nederland (RVO) took months to respond to the Brancheorganisatie Akkerbouw's request for data needed for an agricultural research levy, and whether this delay endangers EUR 1.2 million in projects. The minister confirmed the request was filed in July, cited data protection (Wbp) constraints, and said the BO may obtain KvK numbers of non-member market participants so it can ask them to authorise RVO to share acreage data.
I have decided, within the scope permitted by the Wbp, to enable the Brancheorganisatie (BO) Akkerbouw to obtain from RVO the Chamber of Commerce numbers of non-member market participants.

Ik heb besloten – binnen de ruimte die de Wbp biedt – het de Brancheorganisatie (BO) Akkerbouw mogelijk te maken de Kamer van Koophandel-nummers (KvK-nummers) van de niet bij haar aangesloten marktdeelnemers van RVO te verkrijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Ziengs over het bericht ‘Middenbedrijf weet kapitaalmarkt onvoldoende te vinden’

Two VVD MPs asked the Finance Minister about reports that medium-sized businesses struggle to access capital markets, and about measures such as SME growth markets, prospectus rules, FinTech and alternative financing. The ministers answered that existing financing instruments, the action plan on SME financing and EU capital markets union measures address the problem, and that the prospectus exemption threshold will be raised and further FinTech steps reported before year-end.
The cabinet considers it of great importance that sufficient financing is available for enterprises with a sound business plan.
Het kabinet acht het van groot belang dat er voldoende financiering beschikbaar is voor ondernemingen met een gezond bedrijfsplan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs en Visser over de brief Drinkwatertarieven Evides Recreatieparken Zeeland

MPs Ziengs and Visser asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment whether the sharp water-tariff increases for holiday parks at Evides, caused by fixed charges per address in the BAG register, were justified and compatible with the Drinkwaterwet, and whether gemeenten would remove wrongly registered stacaravans by 1 December 2016. The Minister answered that the tariff matter is for the courts and Evides, that the ILT exercises system-level oversight only, that most parks gain while 36 lose, and that municipalities are responsible for cleaning the register, with monitoring ongoing.
It is now up to the court to judge whether the tariff methodology of the drinking water company is soundly argued and fair in the individual case.
Het is nu aan de rechter om te oordelen of de tariefsmethodiek van het drinkwaterbedrijf deugdelijk is beargumenteerd en rechtvaardig is in het individuele geval.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Ziengs over rattenoverlast

MPs Lodders and Ziengs asked the government about rising rat infestations, the increase in Weil's disease cases, the effectiveness of Integrated Pest Management and rodenticide use, and whether doctors are informed. The government answered that monitoring is still too short for firm trends, that Integrated Pest Management is essential, that cases rose but not tenfold, and that it will evaluate the policy with results expected in 2021.
The number of patients has not increased tenfold in the past year.
Het aantal patiënten is het afgelopen jaar niet verachtvoudigd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs, Visser en Bruins over het bericht ‘Drenthe naar Tweede Kamer om borden TT en Wildlands’

MPs asked why Rijkswaterstaat enforced a 1.5 million visitor threshold to deny signposting to the TT circuit and Wildlands, despite exceptions elsewhere and public investment in the access road. The minister answered that the rule is uniform for verkeersveiligheid reasons, kept the southern sign, ordered the others removed, and rejected renewed talks.
An exception is therefore made for the signpost coming from the south on the A28; that sign may remain.
Voor het verwijsbord komend uit zuidelijke richting op de A28 wordt daarom een uitzondering gemaakt; dat bord mag blijven staan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs en Aukje de Vries over de berichten ‘Politiek neemt zzp'ers niet serieus’ en ‘Zzp'er in de war door wet tegen schijnzelfstandigheid’

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about uncertainty among freelancers and clients over the Dutch DBA law on false self-employment and model contracts, and whether the Tax Authority is cooperative. The State Secretary answered that the Tax Authority is cooperative and that the DBA law stays in its current form, citing ongoing information campaigns, model contracts and branch-specific account teams.
The Tax Authority has a cooperative attitude towards the submitters of contracts.
De Belastingdienst heeft een coöperatieve houding naar de indieners van overeenkomsten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs en Aukje de Vries over het bericht “Zzp’er verwacht schade door nieuwe wetgeving”

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about reports that freelancers expect harm from the new Wet DBA and about unclear enforcement, sector support, boetes and administrative burden. The government answered that the Belastingdienst will not enforce repressively until 1 May 2017 except in three named situations, that it will publish questions and answers and a summary of inquiries, and that it monitors implementation through consultations and stakeholder channels.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs en Van Oosten over moleculaire drugs die niet onder de Opiumwet vallen

MPs Ziengs and Van Oosten (VVD) asked about reports that new molecular drugs fall outside the Opium Act, the online trade in such drugs, and related research. The state secretary answered that existing procedures (CAM, EMCDDA, WHO risk assessments) can place substances under the Opium Act, that current enforcement against online drug trade is adequate, and that pending WODC and Trimbos studies will be sent to parliament.
I consider the current effort adequate.
Ik acht de huidige inzet afdoende.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Ziengs over het bericht “Schrap het verpandingsverbod”

Two VVD MPs asked the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers about the proposal to lift the ban on pledging claims (verpandingsverbod) to ease SME credit. The minister answered that the problem lies in contractual clauses rather than statute, that a statutory change would be a restriction on freedom of contract, that talks with the banks and factoring association are ongoing, and that a decision will follow after stakeholder consultation.
On this basis, the final decision on the proposal made will take place.
Op basis hiervan zal de definitieve besluitvorming over het gedane voorstel plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ziengs over de explosieve groei van het aantal comazuipers

An MP asked the state secretary for Health about the sharp rise in youth alcohol-related hospital admissions (comazuipers), including its causes, the role of social sources of alcohol, and enforcement in bars. The state secretary acknowledged the trend, cited national figures showing a 19% rise in youth alcohol admissions, said the cause is unclear, and pointed to evaluation of the Drank- en Horecawet and planned enforcement measures if compliance does not improve.
I am currently also considering whether and how the harmful effects of alcohol use could be included in the campaign.
Ik bekijk op het moment ook of en op welke manier schadelijke gevolgen van alcoholgebruik een plaats zouden kunnen krijgen in de campagne.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs en Rudmer Heerema over het bericht ‘Uitbraak Zikavirus: miljoenen besmettingen verwacht’ en ‘Experts waarschuwen: Zikavirus deze zomer in Zuid-Europa’

Two VVD MPs asked the health minister about reports of Zika virus outbreaks and the risk of spread to the Netherlands, including mosquito control, pregnancy advice and wetland effects. The minister answered that Aedes mosquitoes cannot establish in Europe, that monitoring by RIVM and WHO continues, and that a RIVM/NVWA policy advice on native mosquitoes is delayed to around March 2016.
As soon as I have received this policy advice, I will send it to the House of Representatives.
Zodra ik dit beleidsadvies ontvangen heb zal ik deze de Kamer doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Ziengs over de Radar-uitzending over arbeidsongeschiktheidsverzekeringen

MPs Aukje de Vries and Ziengs asked the Finance Minister about a Radar broadcast alleging that disability insurers refuse payouts over unreported, unconscious omissions made at application, and whether applicants should be screened in advance. The minister replied that the duty to disclose and the Protocol Verzekeringskeuringen apply, insurers may refuse only where non-disclosed facts matter, an industry form revision is underway, and the AFM has examined advice quality and is considering fines.
The AFM has in the past investigated how disability insurance works in practice, including the aspects raised in the Radar broadcast of 18 January.
De AFM heeft in het verleden onderzoek gedaan naar de werking van arbeidsongeschiktheidsverzekeringen, ook naar de aspecten die in de Radar-uitzending op 18 januari jl aan de orde kwamen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ziengs over het bericht ‘Feest-bv’s ontlopen Drankwet met truc; Baromzet weggeboekt in apart bedrijfje’

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about sports clubs and similar bodies moving bar activities into separate 'party BVs' to avoid the Alcohol Act and whether the Market and Government Act protects entrepreneurs from unfair competition. The minister replied that the Market and Government Act only binds government bodies, not such clubs, that ACM has no enforcement role here, and that subsidy rules fall under the General Administrative Law Act, with a fuller evaluation response to follow.
In my response to the evaluation of the law, which I will send to your House shortly, I will go further into the results of the evaluation
In mijn reactie op de evaluatie van de wet, die ik binnenkort aan uw Kamer zal sturen, zal ik verder ingaan op de resultaten van de evaluatie
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs en Lodders over concurrentieverstoring door subsidieregelingen

Two VVD MPs asked whether the subsidy to LTO for the 'beveilig mijn boerenbedrijf' project led to only one supplier being chosen per product, and whether subsidy rules should require multiple suppliers. The minister confirmed LTO selected the suppliers itself and said the government sees no need for supplier-selection rules in specific subsidy schemes beyond existing competition law.
The cabinet sees no reason to set rules in specific subsidy schemes in this area, beyond the applicable competition laws and regulations.
Het kabinet ziet geen aanleiding om, naast de geldende wet- en regelgeving ter bevordering van concurrentie, op dat terrein ook regels te stellen in specifieke subsidieregelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Anne Mulder en Ziengs over het artikel 'Brede cao biedt zekerheid voor alle werkenden”

Two VVD MPs asked whether minimum rates for self-employed workers (zzp'ers) set in collective labour agreements, as proposed by FNV and agreed in the architecture sector, are acceptable and lawful under competition rules. The minister answered that such clauses likely fall under the cartel prohibition, that the ACM supervises this, and that the government is not aware of consultation with zzp'ers, without committing to any new action.

Collective labour agreement provisions concerning self-employed persons without staff who qualify as undertakings under competition law, and which contain tariff agreements for them, will most likely fall under the cartel prohibition of the Competition Act.

Cao-bepalingen die zien op zelfstandigen zonder personeel die kwalificeren als ondernemer in de zin van het mededingingsrecht en die afspraken bevatten over tarieven voor deze zelfstandigen zullen hoogstwaarschijnlijk onder het kartelverbod uit de Mededingingswet vallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ziengs over het gebruik van ADHD-middelen voor recreatieve doeleinden

An MP asked the health minister about the Utrecht study estimating that about one in five Dutch secondary pupils on ADHD medication takes methylphenidate for non-medical reasons, illegal resale, data on use, and whether guidelines for prescribing should be tightened. The minister called the signals worrying, stated that illegal resale is prohibited and penalised, cited prescription data and ongoing studies, and pointed to existing professional guidelines without committing to new rules.
Indications of the scale and extent of trade in, or improper use of, ADHD medication are lacking.
Indicaties voor schaal en omvang van de handel in dan wel het oneigenlijk gebruik van ADHD-medicatie ontbreken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs en Lodders over een nieuwe Europese richtlijn over antibioticagebruik

MPs Ziengs and Lodders asked whether the new EU antibiotic guidelines for animal husbandry fall short of Dutch rules and how the Netherlands will push for stronger EU action during its presidency. The State Secretary replied that the guidelines are non-binding, draw on Dutch experience, and that the Netherlands will advocate stricter EU rules and raise the issue at a February ministerial conference.
I agree with you that the approach to antibiotic resistance must be addressed at European level.
Ik deel met u dat de aanpak van antibioticaresistentie op Europees niveau moet worden opgepakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Ziengs naar aanleiding van een werkbezoek aan een pluimveeslachterij op 19 oktober 2015

MPs Lodders and Ziengs asked why the NVWA refused the poultry sector's request to keep slaughterhouses running on 26 and 27 December, and why it handled the request slowly and charged waiting costs to the company. The State Secretary answered that the NVWA allowed a one-time exception for 26 December with conditions, that the sector was informed, and that the claim procedure for NVWA-caused losses exists.
The NVWA will allow poultry slaughterhouses, on a one-time basis, to submit applications for inspections on Saturday 26 December (Second Christmas Day).
De NVWA zal eenmalig voor pluimveeslachterijen toestaan om aanvragen voor keuringen op zaterdag 26 december (Tweede Kerstdag) in te dienen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ziengs over roken in tuinen en balkons

An MP from the VVD asked the state secretary whether people should be free to smoke in their own gardens and balconies, and how to respond to Clean Air Nederland's call for neighbour-smoke lawsuits and its ANBI status. The state secretary answered that there is no smoking ban in private homes and legislation is not the right answer, that neighbours should talk things through, that the ANBI status question is for the Tax Administration, and that whether to pursue a test case is for the organisation itself.
There is however no ban on smoking in the home environment, and I am of the view that legislation is also not the right answer.
Er geldt echter geen verbod op roken in de thuisomgeving en ik ben van mening dat wetgeving ook niet het juiste antwoord is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ziengs over het stilleggen van Nederlands grieponderzoek

MP Ziengs asked the minister whether Dutch avian flu research had stopped because of tighter US funding conditions on gain-of-function work, and what the consequences for publication, biosecurity and vaccine development would be. The minister confirmed that US funders have tightened safety requirements, said the Dutch-funded avian flu research is not being stopped and can continue if those conditions are met, and pointed to existing Dutch biosecurity and export-control rules.
The avian flu research funded by the Netherlands is not being stopped.
Het door Nederland gefinancierde vogelgrieponderzoek wordt niet stopgezet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs, Gesthuizen, Agnes Mulder en Verhoeven over de aanbesteding van boekscanners en de digitalisering van rijksarchieven door het Nationaal Archief

MPs from VVD, SP, CDA and D66 asked the minister why the Nationaal Archief's digitisation of national archives is being in-sourced to the Belastingdienst rather than tendered, despite a parliamentary motion and the Commission of Procurement Experts' advice against it. The minister defends in-sourcing as lawful internal shared services, citing cost, logistics and business-case reasons, while acknowledging the earlier letter wording on loan of scanners was unfortunate and deferring answers pending a research report.
Reversing the in-sourcing of the work, as the motion requests, would lead to a further delay of, expected, at least one year.
Terugdraaien van de inbesteding van de werkzaamheden, zoals de motie vraagt, leidt tot een verdere vertraging van, naar verwachting, minimaal een jaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Ziengs over de subsidieregeling beveiliging agrarische bedrijven

MPs Lodders and Ziengs asked whether a subsidy scheme for securing agricultural businesses favours a single supplier, distorting competition and consumer choice. The minister answered that a one-off subsidy went to the LTO Nederland farmers' organisation, which selected six products and suppliers based on a member survey, and that farmers remain free to choose other products.
A one-off subsidy was granted to the Land- en Tuinbouworganisatie (LTO Nederland) for a project aimed at raising awareness of the risk of falling victim to crime among agricultural entrepreneurs.

Er is een eenmalige subsidie toegekend aan de Land- en Tuinbouworganisatie (LTO Nederland) voor een project dat is gericht op de bewustwording van risico's op slachtofferschap van criminaliteit bij agrarische ondernemers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries, Schut-Welkzijn en Ziengs over het bericht “Negen manieren om je als zzp-er goedkoper te verzekeren”

Three VVD MPs asked the ministers whether the disability insurance market for self-employed workers offers enough cheaper 'adapted' policies, whether rules or advice obligations block them, and whether the 13-week registration deadline for voluntary insurance should be extended. Minister Asscher replied that many options exist, that no legal barriers are known, that the AFM sees room for better advice, and that extending the deadline is not favoured because of adverse selection, promising to return to the issue after the IBO zzp.
In the context of the IBO zzp and the Weyenberg motion, I will return to the insurability of the disability risk.
In het kader van het IBO zzp en de motie Weyenberg 3 , zal ik terugkomen op de verzekerbaarheid van het arbeidsongeschiktheidsrisico.

Vragen van de leden Ziengs en Rutte (beiden VVD) aan de Minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de aanbesteding van boekscanners en de digitalisering van rijksarchieven door het Nationaal Archief (ingezonden 1

MPs Ziengs and Rutte (VVD) asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science why the National Archives runs the tender for 16 book scanners that will be placed with the Tax Authority, and why digitisation of state archives is being insourced rather than tendered to market firms. The Minister replied that the scanners are state property placed at the Tax Authority, that the in-house arrangement was chosen for practical, quality and cost reasons and in line with coalition policy, and that the Tax Authority's Heerlen unit is a shared government service provider.
The submitted offers from suppliers of scanning equipment contain market-sensitive, confidential information that cannot be made public in this context.
De ingediende offertes van leveranciers van scanapparatuur bevatten marktgevoelige, vertrouwelijke informatie die in dit verband niet publiek gemaakt kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Aukje de Vries en Ziengs over regeldrift

MPs asked whether the government finds it acceptable that insurers demand extensive documents from employers before advising on pension schemes, given the aim to cut administrative burden. The minister says the Wft uses open norms, the AFM guidelines are not a checklist, the burden is hard to estimate and is not tracked, and the Actal study on financial-sector regulation will examine similar cases.
Because there are various ways to gather information from the client, the administrative burden arising from this cannot be reliably estimated.
Vanwege de verschillende mogelijkheden om informatie bij de klant in te winnen zijn de administratieve lasten die hieruit voortkomen niet goed in te schatten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ziengs over kostenefficiënte en lastenluwe toepassing van aanbestedingsregels

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about communication between contracting authorities and bidders, over- and under-specification of tenders, SME barriers (social return, sustainability, certificates), EMVI costs, PPS for ICT and contract management under the Aanbestedingswet 2012. The minister replied that the ongoing evaluation of the Act will cover these issues, pointed to existing tools (market consultation, nota van inlichtingen, Commissie van Aanbestedingsexperts, civil court) and declined to adopt a general code of conduct for now.
I do not want to anticipate this evaluation because that would risk presenting an unrepresentative picture.
Ik wil niet vooruitlopen op deze evaluatie omdat daarmee het risico bestaat dat er een niet representatief beeld wordt geschetst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Ziengs over het bericht "Gebrek aan MKB-krediet remt groei Nederland"

MPs Aukje de Vries and Ziengs asked the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers about OECD and ECB findings that limited SME credit is slowing Dutch growth and about the effects of bank capital rules. The ministers answered that weakened SME finances and lower domestic demand explain falling credit, that DNB finds banks can meet the new rules under the baseline scenario, and that further measures will be reported.
The cabinet will inform the House shortly about the effects of the accumulation of regulation on the banking sector and credit provision.
Het kabinet zal de Kamer op korte termijn informeren over de effecten van de stapeling van regelgeving op de bancaire sector en de kredietverlening.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leegte, De Liefde en Ziengs over activiteiten van netbeheerbedrijven op de markt voor laadpalen voor elektrische auto’s

MPs from the VVD asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether grid operators' commercial activity in the electric vehicle charging-point market, via subsidiary Allego, creates an unfair level playing field and whether this should be prohibited. The minister acknowledged the risk of cross-subsidy and unequal advantage, said grid operators should only perform statutory tasks in the forthcoming STROOM bill, and committed to clearer rules, transparent accounting and publication of anonymised information.
Grid operators may only carry out statutory tasks.
Netbeheerders mogen alleen wettelijke taken uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra, Ziengs en Van Veen over het artikel 'Miljoenenstrop door stoffen'

MPs Dijkstra, Ziengs and Van Veen asked about the European Commission's plan to add five substances to the RoHS II restriction list, whether the process followed REACH procedures, and what the costs and benefits would be. The Secretary of State answered that the Commission acted within the RoHS framework after consulting member states and stakeholders, that the costs are real but the benefits of phasing out hazardous substances justify them, and that the government sees no reason to intervene, while it will monitor exemption applications.
I therefore see no reason to hold the Commission to account on this.
Ik zie dan ook geen aanleiding de Commissie hierop aan te spreken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs, Agnes Mulder en Wolbert over de dreigende sluiting van attractiepark De Sprookjeshof in Zuidlaren

MPs Ziengs, Agnes Mulder and Wolbert asked about the threatened closure of the De Sprookjeshof amusement park, the inconsistent certification of identical attractions by inspection bodies, and whether the government is responsible for consistent rules. The minister answered that certification rules were applied correctly, that individual inspection was required for unique slides, that operators bear primary responsibility for compliance, and that the answers could not be sent by the requested date.
On 12 September the NVWA held consultations with the CdK Drenthe, where it was agreed that the inspection body and the owner of De Sprookjeshof will again consult on measures that ensure safety.

Op 12 september heeft de NVWA met de CdK Drenthe overleg gevoerd waarbij is afgesproken dat de keuringsinstelling en de eigenaar van De Sprookjeshof opnieuw in overleg gaan over de maatregelen die de veiligheid waarborgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs en Lucas over het bericht ‘Chinese horeca onder druk door gebrek aan koks’

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about shortages of Chinese cooks and UWV's handling of work permits and job-matching for the Asian catering sector. The minister defended the labour-market test and UWV procedures, said the UWV project placed few workers, and promised further talks with the sector and UWV on a temporary solution.
I am willing to talk with UWV to examine whether the application can be simplified on a number of aspects, provided this information can be obtained in advance in another way.
Ik wil wel met UWV in gesprek gaan om te onderzoeken of op een aantal aspecten de aanvraag kan worden vereenvoudigd, mits deze informatie dan wel op een andere wijze vooraf verkregen kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ziengs over de nieuwe regels omtrent aanbesteden en het bevorderen van het samen met het bedrijfsleven opstellen van algemene inkoopvoorwaarden

MP Ziengs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs how the motion on co-drafting general procurement terms with business is being implemented, whether central and local governments involve business in drafting them, and what is being done. The minister replied that the state general terms were revised with business consultation, a periodic consultation with business associations has started, and the VNG's model terms were drafted with a stakeholder advisory group, with alternative clauses offered where consensus was lacking.
Furthermore, business will be closely involved at the end of next year in the planned evaluation of the ARIV 2014 and ARVODI 2014.
Voorts zal het bedrijfsleven eind volgend jaar nauw worden betrokken bij de voorgenomen evaluatie van de ARIV 2014 en de ARVODI 2014.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs, Aukje de Vries en Mei Li Vos over premieverhogingen van arbeidsongeschiktheidsverzekeringen voor ZZP’ers

MPs Ziengs, Aukje de Vries and Mei Li Vos asked about insurers raising disability insurance premiums for self-employed workers via en-bloc clauses, including questions on legal limits, complaint routes, switching options and AFM oversight. The minister answered that insurers must apply such clauses reasonably and sparingly, that the AFM and DNB oversee communication and solvency, and that the AFM will explore the product's cost-efficiency and en-bloc use.
The AFM will, from its product oversight and product development process supervision, start an exploration into the use of the en bloc clause in disability insurance.

In het licht hiervan zal de AFM vanuit het toezicht op producten – en productontwikkelingsproces (PPP) een verkenning starten naar het gebruik van de en bloc clausule bij arbeidsongeschiktheidsverzekeringen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten en Ziengs over de flexibilisering van huurcontracten

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers whether the fixed terms of commercial lease contracts make shop premises inflexible and whether Dutch lease law allows short leases. The minister replied that the Civil Code balances landlord and tenant interests, that 5-year terms can be shortened to 2 years or less, and that a stakeholder platform (Winkeltop) is working on the vacancy problem.
All in all, a considerable degree of flexibility is provided.
Er wordt al met al de nodige flexibiliteit gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Ziengs over het bericht "DDB wil meer informatie ZuivelNL"

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers of Economic Affairs about reports that the Dutch Dairy Board wants more information on the new dairy chain body ZuivelNL, including a levy of EUR 0.05 per 100 kg milk, and whether interbranch organisations may take over productschap tasks and use general binding declarations. The minister answered that the LTO-NZO cooperation is not yet a recognised interbranch organisation under the CAP, that the levy is a voluntary private contribution rather than a statutory levy, that public tasks remain with the ministry and no general binding declaration applies, and that a framework regulation will be published in the second quarter of 2014.
A private organisation is free to ask its voluntarily affiliated participants for a financial contribution, whether or not it is an interbranch organisation within the meaning of the CAP.
Het staat een private organisatie, of dit nu een brancheorganisatie in de zin van het GLB is of niet, vrij om een financiële bijdrage te vragen aan de (vrijwillig) aangesloten deelnemers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Ziengs over werelderfgoed Wadden

MPs Aukje de Vries and Ziengs asked the ministers about a Waddenvereniging report on opportunities from Wadden Sea World Heritage status, including tourism limits, whether the status added restrictions, and the tourism strategy. State Secretary Dijksma answered that the status adds no extra restrictions beyond existing law, pointed to promotion and a trilateral tourism strategy due at the February 2014 conference, and said the status did not itself impose new limits.
The World Heritage status in itself does not impose any additional restrictions or rules.
De werelderfgoedstatus op zich levert géén extra beperkingen of regels op.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ziengs over het aanbesteden van onderhoud en reparatie

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the Aanbestedingswet 2012 omitted the NACE-over-CPV priority rule, causing maintenance and repair contracts to be tendered at EU level unnecessarily and disadvantaging Dutch SMEs. The minister replied that the annexes handle the classification, that contracting authorities may choose procedures proportionately, and that the government supports a single CPV classification in EU revisions.
The Netherlands is committed to simplifying regulations.
Nederland zet zich in voor vereenvoudiging van regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Boer en Ziengs over aanbesteding van busvervoer

Two VVD MPs asked whether regional tender requirements such as high turnover and public transport experience exclude new entrants from regional bus concessions, and whether small private bus operators could be considered. The state secretary said tender requirements are public, that regions have wide discretion under EU and national rules, and that the points will be raised with a working group on more flexible tenders.
Therefore I will bring the points you mentioned (turnover and public transport experience requirements) to the attention of the working group
Daarom zal ik de door u genoemde punten (eisen van omzet en ervaring met openbaar vervoer) onder de aandacht brengen van de werkgroep
Antwoord vragen Lucas, Neppérus en Ziengs over regeldruk door informatieuitvragen van de Centrale Dienst voor In- en Uitvoer van de Belastingdienst en van het Centraal Bureau voor de Statistiek

MPs Lucas, Neppérus and Ziengs (VVD) asked whether the CDIU and CBS collect statistics from contracting authorities and businesses in burdensome ways, such as postal-only responses and malfunctioning CBS software. The minister replied that TED data is incomplete, so missing data is requested directly, that the new Aanbestedingswet moves notifications to TenderNed, and that about 98% of statistical burden on businesses stems from EU regulation, with CBS working to reduce it.
The intention is to have the collection of data related to the statistical obligation go electronically via TenderNed in the future.
Het is de bedoeling om in de toekomst de verzameling van gegevens in verband met de statistiekverplichting elektronisch via TenderNed te laten verlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ziengs over het toenemend aantal regels

An MP asks the Economic Affairs minister whether the number of regulations has risen, whether decentralisation explains this, and how regulatory burden is defined and reduced. The minister says decentralisation adds local tailoring that increases rules but lowers measured burden, outlines a 2.5 billion euro burden-reduction target and joint programmes with municipalities.
It is not for me to judge the quality of regulation by decentralised governments.
Het is niet aan mij om te oordelen over de kwaliteit van regelgeving van decentrale overheden.

Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Oosten en Ziengs over het vonnis van de Rechtbank Noord-Nederland d.d. 20 februari 2013 en daaropvolgende publicaties op de website van VNO-NCW d.d. 21 februari 2013 inzake acquisitiefrau

MPs Van Oosten and Ziengs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a court ruling on acquisition fraud and VNO-NCW's call for political action, including whether legislation should protect small businesses as consumers are protected. The minister reported the damage figures, outlined preventive and enforcement measures, declined comment on the pending case, and said EU-wide action is preferred over national legislation, with alternatives still being explored.
Since the period for appeal in this court case is still running, I refrain from substantive comment on this ruling.
Aangezien de termijn voor hoger beroep in deze rechtszaak nog loopt, onthoud ik mij van inhoudelijk commentaar op deze uitspraak.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Neppérus en Ziengs over lasten bij invoer van biologische wijnen

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance why organic wines imported into the Netherlands must be re-certified as organic even though they already met EU rules in the country of origin, and whether similar rules apply to other organic products. The reply states that Customs has no role in checking organic status, that EU Regulation 834/2007 requires certification of traders selling organic products to business buyers, that Skal performs these checks as an EU obligation, and that Skal keeps the burden low through risk-based inspection.
These checks by the Skal foundation are a European obligation.
Deze controles door stichting Skal zijn een Europese verplichting.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder, Wolbert en Ziengs over het verklaren van Ruinerwold tot een beschermd dorpsgezicht door de Rijksdienst voor het Cultureel Erfgoed

Three MPs asked why the Rijksdienst voor het Cultureel Erfgoed designates Ruinerwold as a protected village view despite opposition from the municipal council and the province, and what this means for economic development and solar panels. The minister explains the designation procedure, that municipal and provincial advice plays an important role but cultural-historical values are leading, and that the municipality decides on permits without blocking development or renewable energy.
The cultural-historical values are leading in the designation procedure, but the advice of the municipal council and Provincial Executive plays an important role in the weighing towards the decision.
De cultuurhistorische waarden zijn bij de aanwijzingsprocedure leidend, maar de adviezen van de gemeenteraad en van Gedeputeerde Staten spelen een belangrijke rol bij de afweging tot het besluit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ziengs over de proportionaliteit van een Europese aanbesteding van sleepdiensten door de inkoopafdeling van de politie

An MP asked whether the police joint-procurement body's Europe-wide tender for towing and storage services, which bundles contracts and sets a EUR 5 million turnover requirement, is proportionate and whether it will exclude small firms. The minister answered that the tender is lawful under current rules, the turnover requirement is within case-law limits, and that the new Procurement Act will restrict such requirements from April 2013.
Under the currently applicable rules, I consider this tender proportionate.
Onder de nu geldende regelgeving acht ik deze aanbesteding proportioneel.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Ziengs en Van Veen over de economische kosten van mislukte bedrijfsoverdrachten

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the economic costs of failed business transfers, citing a report claiming EUR 4 billion annual turnover loss and 80,000 jobs lost. The minister rejected the report's conclusions as based on a hypothetical total-inactivity assumption, pointed to existing support (KvK advice, guarantee schemes), and saw no need for additional measures.
No, I cannot endorse these conclusions, because the study assumed the hypothetical situation that all failed business transfers and closures of healthy firms lead to total inactivity.

Nee, ik kan deze conclusies niet onderschrijven, doordat in het onderzoek is uitgegaan van de hypothetische situatie dat alle mislukte bedrijfsoverdrachten en opheffingen van gezonde bedrijven leiden tot totale inactiviteit.
Antwoord vragen van de leden De Boer en Ziengs over de rijksgebouwen in Veenhuizen

MPs De Boer and Ziengs asked the Minister of Interior about federal buildings in Veenhuizen, including who is responsible for their use and whether a vocational school initiative (Metzelaar PraktijkGilde) could be housed there at comparable rents. The minister answered that responsibility depends on ownership (state assets managed by RVOB and Rijksgebouwendienst), that a market-rate lease offer was made but not agreed, and that the state cannot give targeted incentives without risking unlawful state aid.
There is no need to investigate this, since in April 2012 a lease offer at market-conform terms was made to Metzelaar PraktijkGilde for the building at Hospitaallaan 1.
Het is niet nodig om dit te onderzoeken aangezien er in april 2012 een huuraanbieding is gedaan aan Metzelaar PraktijkGilde tegen marktconforme voorwaarden voor het pand aan de Hospitaallaan 1.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ziengs over het concept VNG-model algemene inkoopvoorwaarden voor de levering van diensten

An MP asked the minister about the VNG model general purchasing conditions for services, including liability, intellectual property transfer and proportionality under the government's Proportionality Guide. The minister answered that the model is optional and can be deviated from, that the proportionality guide will be designated as a guideline with the new procurement act, and that deviations must be motivated.
The Proportionality Guide will be designated as a guideline by general administrative order when the proposed new Procurement Act enters into force.
De Gids proportionaliteit zal bij inwerkingtreding van het voorstel voor een nieuwe Aanbestedingswet bij AMvB worden aangewezen als richtsnoer.
Antwoord vragen Hennis-Passchaert en Ziengs over het doen van aangifte door bedrijven

Two VVD MPs asked the Justice Minister why companies filing online reports are still asked to come to the police station, why camera evidence cannot be attached, and whether reports are refused when employees damage company vehicles off-duty. The minister replied that evidence should be collected fully, that the police are expanding internet reporting and a tracking system, that complex cases are invited to the station, and that police must take a report unless no offence is possible.
The law prescribes that investigating officers are obliged to record a report (article 163, fifth paragraph, Sv).
De wet schrijft voor dat opsporingsambtenaren verplicht zijn een aangifte op te nemen (artikel 163, vijfde lid Sv).
Vragen van de leden Aptroot en Ziengs (beiden VVD) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het artikel «ZZP chauffeurs worden vervangen door buitenlandse» (ingezonden 23 september 2011).

Two VVD MPs asked the minister whether the rule requiring an employment relationship for freight drivers under the Wet wegvervoer goederen harms Dutch self-employed drivers and whether it would be changed quickly. The minister answered that the requirement was kept by parliament to protect drivers, that an evaluation is due in early 2012, and that the requirement's future will be discussed then.
That is the moment when I would like to discuss with your House whether or not to withdraw the requirement of an employment relationship.
Dat is het moment waarop ik graag met uw Kamer de discussie wil voeren over het al dan niet intrekken van de eis van dienstbetrekking.

Vragen van de leden Ziengs en Snijder-Hazelhoff (VVD) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de aansluiting van kleine, lokale netwerken zonder veiligheidsrisico’s op het digitale Klic-systeem

MPs Ziengs and Snijder-Hazelhoff asked whether enforcement under the WION underground utilities law still hits small recreational businesses with no safety risk, whether fines can reach 100,000 euro, and whether these networks should be exempt from the digital KLIC system given the costs. The minister answered that only one recreational operator was registered, which then withdrew after contact; the 100,000 euro is the statutory maximum fine; some exemptions exist but not for third-party supply; and he will review proportionality in the upcoming WION evaluation, with no enforcement in the meantime.
I am therefore willing to look at the proportionality of the current WION relative to recreational businesses.
Ik ben daarom bereid te kijken naar de proportionaliteit van de huidige WION ten opzichte van de recreatieondernemers.

Vragen van de leden Venrooy-van Ark en Ziengs (beiden VVD) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de overgang van zorgaanbieders van PGB naar zorg in natura (ingezonden 27 september 2011).
