Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary for Health about PGB-based care providers, including sole traders, being excluded from contracting for in-kind care in 2012 and about procedural barriers and the lack of appeal against refusals. The State Secretary answered that contracting is at the discretion of the care offices, promised extra funds and talks with insurers on adjusting the criteria, and said a notice of objection is possible.
It is incorrect that a care provider has no options to contest a negative decision by the care office.
Het is onjuist dat een zorgaanbieder geen mogelijkheden heeft om een negatief besluit van het zorgkantoor aan te vechten.

Vragen van de leden Van der Steur en Ziengs (beiden VVD) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bestaan van onverzekerde en niet verzekerbare risico’s uit het verleden voor werkgevers (ingezonden 26 april 20

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether Supreme Court rulings from 2001 to 2009 effectively imposed a retroactive insurance duty on employers for work-related traffic accident damage that was then uninsurable, and whether employers could fairly be held liable. The minister answered that the 2008 rulings do apply to earlier accidents but that insurance options were then limited, so employers are unlikely to face large liabilities, and he considered the insurance route rather than the general liability policy to be the current solution.
It is therefore likely that the insurance duty also covers those accidents.
Aannemelijk is daarom dat de verzekeringsplicht ook ziet op die ongevallen.
Vragen de leden De Boer en Ziengs (beiden VVD) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het artikel «Nieuwbouwwoning kost circa 50 000 euro meer» (ingezonden 19 april 2011).

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Interior about a newspaper report that new-build homes cost about 50,000 euros more because of Dutch regulation, and whether he would analyse the price effects of building rules. The minister agreed that construction regulation raises dwelling costs, noted energy-saving benefits, and said he is willing to address building costs, though the study offers limited basis for the requested analysis and he will return to it via the Dekker committee recommendations.
The aforementioned study offers less grounding for the requested analysis because it focuses mainly on the cost effect of regulation and not on its cost-saving effect.
Voornoemde studie biedt minder houvast voor de gevraagde analyse omdat deze vooral op het kosteneffect van regelgeving let en niet op het kostenbesparend effect daarvan.

Vragen van de leden Ziengs en Azmani (beiden VVD) aan de ministers van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het feit dat door toedoen van de arbeidsinspectie goedwillende

VVD MPs asked the ministers whether the labour inspectorate's fining of employers who unknowingly hired foreign workers, due to incomplete government information, is acceptable and whether information provision and fine mitigation could be improved. The ministers answered that government information is adequate, fines can be moderated when fault is limited, and an information campaign and inter-agency coordination are ongoing, without committing to new rules.

If after finding a violation of the Foreign Workers Act it appears that an employer made sufficient efforts to ensure lawful implementation and can show they bear no blame for the violation, no fine will be imposed.

Indien na constatering van een overtreding van de Wet arbeid vreemdelingen blijkt dat een werkgever zich voldoende heeft ingespannen om een wetsconforme uitvoering te bewerkstelligen en hij aannemelijk kan maken dat hem voor de geconstateerde overtreding geen enkel verwijt treft, dan zal ook geen boete worden opgelegd.

Vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Ziengs (beiden VVD) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over subsidies voor innovatieve technologieën voor de Floriadetentoonstelling 2012 in Venlo (ingezonden 1

Two VVD MPs asked the minister of Economic Affairs whether subsidies for the Floriade 2012 Villa Flora office park were tied to using the most innovative climate technology, and whether an innovative heat exchanger was dropped after impossible conditions and a less innovative supplier was chosen. The minister confirmed the contractor chose another supplier on its own assessment, said the national Unique Opportunities subsidy (EUR 500,000) does not require the most innovative technologies but only an energy performance target, and left the regional subsidies to the region's own responsibility.
As for the subsidies granted by the municipalities and the province, I would note that the region has its own responsibility to deploy the financial resources effectively.

Voor wat betreft de subsidieverlening van de gemeenten en provincie wil ik opmerken dat de regio hierin haar eigen verantwoordelijkheid heeft om de financiële middelen op een effectieve manier in te zetten.

Vragen van de leden Snijder-Hazelhoff en Ziengs (beiden VVD) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het voorkomen van onnodige aansluiting van kleine, lokale netwerken zonder veiligheidsrisico'

Two VVD MPs asked the minister of Economic Affairs whether small local networks without safety risks, such as recreation businesses, should be exempted from mandatory connection to the Klic-online system given high digitisation costs. The minister answered that existing exemptions under the RION already cover such private networks, that a further exemption is unnecessary, and that the ministry will communicate with the RECRON sector association.
Yes, I agree with that. The Kadaster and the Agentschap Telecom are the organisations that have informed me of this.
Ja, daar ben ik het mee eens. Het Kadaster en het Agentschap Telecom zijn de organisaties die mij hierover hebben geïnformeerd.

Vragen van de leden Mulder en Ziengs (beiden VVD) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over uiteenlopende eisen voor drogistenexamens en over het feit dat het Drogisterijcollege geen toezicht houdt op he

Two VVD MPs asked the health minister about differing exam and quality requirements for drogist diplomas and the lack of supervision by the Drogisterijcollege over how the exam is administered online, including identity checks. The minister replied that the ministry has no say over training and exams under self-regulation, that she will push for a minimum standard and a policy framework for examining bodies, and that exam bodies must ensure identity verification and publish lists of certified graduates.
I will strongly urge that this consultation now proceeds promptly.
Ik zal er met klem op aandringen dat dit overleg nu voortvarend tot stand komt.

Vragen van de leden Van der Burg en Ziengs (beiden VVD) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het bericht dat 2011 een duur jaar belooft te wo

Two VVD MPs asked why municipal taxes for small entrepreneurs were reported to rise 3.5 to 4.8 percent in 2011 and whether this burdens local business, and asked what measures would stop municipalities shifting their financial problems onto SMEs. The minister replied that the figures are not yet reliable, that municipalities set local levies autonomously within legal limits, that the cabinet monitors overall burdens and will raise concerns in the upcoming intergovernmental agreement, and that the cabinet's aim is moderate local burden growth.
Municipalities additionally have an autonomous power to set municipal levies, within the frameworks set by law.
Gemeenten hebben daarnaast een autonome bevoegdheid tot het vaststellen van de gemeentelijke heffingen, binnen de door de wet gestelde kaders.

Vragen van de leden Zijlstra en Ziengs (beiden VVD) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Economische Zaken over de verkoop van alcoholische streekproducten (ingezonden 11 augustus 2010).

MPs Zijlstra and Ziengs (VVD) asked why the Food and Consumer Product Safety Authority (VWA) tolerates sales of low-alcohol regional products at markets and tourist shops in Veere without enforcement, and how this unequal treatment can be ended. The minister explains that a 2005 directive to the VWA, prompted by a parliamentary motion, tolerates such sales at fairs for regional development reasons, denies the practice is unfair competition, and says the directive will not be withdrawn for now.
For the time being I do not intend to withdraw the directive to the VWA.
Voorlopig ben ik niet voornemens de aanwijzing aan de VWA in te trekken.

the right to a personal budget must be fully maintained
het recht op een persoonsgebonden budget onverkort dient te worden gehandhaafd

requests the government, in consultation with patient organisations, to examine how the position of the organisations can be structurally strengthened

Motie Zijlstra en Van Miltenburg over niet hanteren van de kaasschaafmethode

requests the government to make clear choices on possible financial targets in healthcare and not to apply the cheese-slicer method
verzoekt de regering heldere keuzes te maken bij de eventuele financiële taakstellingen in de zorg en niet de «kaasschaafmethode» te hanteren

requests the government to investigate which criteria are relevant for the indication assessment

requests the government to experiment with the ICF classification in AWBZ assessments by the CIZ

Motie Van Miltenburg over onderzoek naar de omvang van de groep licht verstandelijk gehandicapten
Asks the government to investigate the size of the mildly intellectually disabled group and propose coherent cross-cabinet policy for them.
requests the government to investigate the size of the target group
verzoekt de regering de omvang van de doelgroep te onderzoeken

the college of mayor and aldermen to provide understandable information about the choice between the ways an entitlement can be claimed
het college van burgemeester en wethouders om op begrijpelijke wijze inlichtingen te verstrekken over de keuze tussen de verschillende wijzen waarop een aanspraak tot gelding kan worden gebracht
Motie Sap c.s. over netto uitbetalen van het pgb
Asks the government to ensure municipalities pay personal budgets (pgb) net rather than gross and to inform the House of the agreements made with municipalities.
requests the government to ensure municipalities pay the pgb net and to inform the House about the agreements made with municipalities before summer
verzoekt de regering ervoor zorg te dragen dat gemeenten het pgb netto gaan uitbetalen en de Kamer voor de zomer over de met gemeenten gemaakte afspraken te informeren

Writes into the Wmo Act that personal budgets and wage-based payments are forms of non-in-kind assistance, and distinguishes them from financial allowances.
A benefit other than in kind consists of a personal budget or a payment for an employment relationship
Een voorziening anders dan in natura bestaat uit persoonsgebonden budget of een vergoeding voor een arbeidsverhouding
Nader gewijzigd amendement van de leden Van Miltenburg en Van der Vlies dat ertoe strekt het persoonsgebonden budget in de WMo onverkort in de wet overeind te houden

Amends the WMO so that municipalities must give understandable information on choosing between benefit-in-kind and a personal budget, and keeps the personal budget (including alfahulp) open as an option within the law.
the college of mayor and aldermen to provide understandable information on the choice between the different ways an entitlement can be claimed
het college van burgemeester en wethouders om op begrijpelijke wijze inlichtingen te verstrekken over de keuze tussen de verschillende wijzen waarop een aanspraak tot gelding kan worden gebracht
Motie Sap c.s. over het aanspraak kunnen maken op diensten van de SVB voor Wmo-cliënten die kiezen voor een pgb
Asks the government to ensure all Wmo clients choosing a personal budget can use SVB services as employer-administration support.
requests the government to ensure all Wmo clients choosing a personal budget can claim SVB services.
verzoekt de regering er zorg voor te dragen dat alle Wmo-cliënten die kiezen voor een pgb aanspraak kunnen maken op de diensten van de SVB
Nader gewijzigd amendement van de leden Van der Vlies en Van Miltenburg over duidelijke informatie over keuze voor een individuele voorziening
Requires municipalities to inform persons in clear terms, in advance, about the consequences of choosing an individual provision in kind, a personal budget, or a financial allowance.
The municipal executive informs the persons referred to in article 6, first paragraph, in advance, in clear and understandable terms, about the consequences of the choice
Het college van burgemeester en wethouders licht de personen, bedoeld in artikel 6, eerste lid, vooraf in duidelijke en begrijpelijke bewoordingen in over de gevolgen van de keuze
Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Van der Vlies en Van Miltenburg over duidelijke informatie over keuze voor een individuele voorziening
Requires municipalities to inform people choosing between options for an individual care provision, in advance and in clear language, about the consequences, now also covering benefits in kind.
in advance, in clear and understandable terms, about the consequences of the choice
vooraf in duidelijke en begrijpelijke bewoordingen in over de gevolgen van de keuze
Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Van Miltenburg en Van der Vlies over het peroonsgebonden budget in de Wmo
Requires municipalities to explain clearly to citizens the consequences of choosing between a benefit in kind and a personal budget under the Wmo, and keeps the personal budget option open.
the municipal executive to provide understandable information about the choice between the different ways in which an entitlement can be claimed
het college van burgemeester en wethouders om op begrijpelijke wijze inlichtingen te verstrekken over de keuze tussen de verschillende wijzen waarop een aanspraak tot gelding kan worden gebracht
Amendement van het lid Van der Vlies c.s. om pgb en financiële vergoeding expliciet in de wet op te nemen
Writes into the Wmo that a non-in-kind provision may take the form of a personal budget or a financial allowance.

Ja, die mening deel ik en ik heb hierover ook mijn zorgen geuit aan de voorzitter van het College van Procureurs-Generaal.

Er is op dit moment geen duidelijke aanleiding om een dergelijk onderzoek te starten.

Daarom heb ik ook opheldering gevraagd bij de Rijksuniversiteit Groningen en het college van bestuur gevraagd zich te beraden op stappen tegen de studentenvereniging.

qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Haga en Smolders over het feit dat Italiaans huisvuil de woningbouw nog verder op slot zet en de Amsterdamse lucht vervuilt

Two MPs asked whether it is acceptable that weekly trains carry about 900 tonnes of Italian household waste to Amsterdam incinerators, citing CO2 emissions, air pollution, housing construction and public health concerns. The government answered that incineration with energy recovery is accepted while waste cannot yet be processed higher up the hierarchy, that the capacity imbalance explains cross-border transport, that Dutch incinerators must meet strict emission rules, and that the cabinet plans to reduce incineration capacity over time.
The cabinet is working nationally and at EU level to promote the highest possible level of processing, so that ultimately less waste needs to be incinerated or landfilled.
Het kabinet zet nationaal en Europees in op het stimuleren van zo hoogwaardig mogelijke verwerking waardoor er uiteindelijk minder afval moet worden verbrand of gestort.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Haga en Smolders over het azc in Budel

Two Groep Van Haga MPs asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security whether the government will close the Budel asylum centre given local residents' complaints about nuisance and insecurity. The State Secretary acknowledged the concerns, pointed to existing measures such as street patrols and a neighbourhood connection plan, and said he remains in talks with the municipality, province and COA about the centre's future and further measures, without committing to closure.
I am and remain in discussion with the municipality of Cranendonck, the province, the COA and other key partners about the future of the reception centre.
Ik ben en blijf met de gemeente Cranendonck, de provincie, het COA en andere belangrijke partners in gesprek over de toekomst van het aanmeldcentrum.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smolders over de schrikbarende stijging van het aantal daklozen, met name onder jongeren

An MP asks the State Secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport about the sharp rise in homelessness, especially among young people, whether true numbers are higher, and why the National Homelessness Action Plan runs to 2030, and also raises asylum reception policy and migrant worker homelessness. The State Secretary acknowledges the concern, says monitoring is incomplete and pilot counts are planned, defends the 2030 target and the Housing First approach, and rejects the link between asylum inflow and housing shortage.
On the basis of the results of this pilot, I want to take concrete follow-up steps.
Ik wil op basis van de resultaten van deze pilot concrete vervolgstappen zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smolders over 'het bericht dat de helft van de Brabanders kampt met geldzorgen'

An MP asked the Minister for Poverty Policy about reports that half of Brabanders face money worries, with health complaints, poverty by province, a plan to tackle poverty in Brabant, shame around money problems, child hunger in schools and low trust in government measures. The minister acknowledged the link between money worries and health, pointed to income support, debt-prevention and school meal measures, provided national and municipal poverty data, and declined to redirect development aid to domestic poverty.
The cabinet is therefore not willing to deploy development cooperation funds elsewhere.
Het kabinet is daarom niet bereid om de middelen voor ontwikkelingssamenwerking elders in te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smolders over toenemend aantal geweldsincidenten in het openbaar vervoer

MP Smolders asks the state secretary about a rising number of violent incidents in public transport, whether national public transport bans should be standard for aggression, and whether a broader ban covering spitting and weapon possession should be introduced. The state secretary reports 2,327 incidents in 2021 versus 2,083 in 2020, says a trend cannot yet be confirmed, notes 1,050 transport bans issued, rejects a national ban on proportionality grounds, and points to a regional pilot in Eastern Netherlands starting in the second half of 2022 and existing categorisation that already covers spitting and weapons.

A carrier that wants to apply travel or residence bans must, in consultation with the Public Prosecution Service, state in an action plan the specific types of incidents for which it wants to impose the ban.

Een vervoerder die reis- of verblijfsverboden wil gaan toepassen moet in overleg met het Openbaar Ministerie aangeven en in een plan van aanpak omschrijven voor welke concrete typen incidenten de vervoerder het verbod wil kunnen gaan opleggen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Haga, Ephraim en Smolders over juridisch bindende overeenkomsten met het World Economic Forum en aanverwante zaken

MPs Van Haga, Ephraim and Smolders asked whether the government has binding agreements with the World Economic Forum and whether Parliament can inspect them. The minister confirmed binding implementation agreements and grants under Dutch law, said the subsidy decisions are attached, and stated that the WEF is a private Swiss foundation and that the agreements fall within the budget Parliament approves.
Annex 3 contains the subsidy decisions issued by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs to the WEF.
In de bijlage 3 treft u de aan het WEF verstrekte subsidiebeschikkingen van het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken aan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jansen en Smolders over de huisvesting van statushouders

MPs Jansen and Smolders asked the government about the nationalities, residence duration, permit type, housing need and waiting-time impact of the 11,000 refugee-permit holders to be housed in the second half of 2021, and about municipal consequences of missing the quota. The minister answered that nationalities cannot be precisely forecast but gave 2020 outflow figures, that all permits are initially five-year, and that the province supervises municipal quota compliance through a six-step intervention ladder ending in substitution at municipal cost.
No precise breakdown by nationality can be given for this estimate.
Bij deze raming kan geen precieze uitsplitsing naar nationaliteit worden gegeven.

qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kahraman over de situatie van orthodoxe christenen in Ethiopië

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about an attack on Orthodox Christians in Woldiya, Ethiopia, requesting condemnation, pressure for an independent investigation, and raising religious minority protection in bilateral contacts. The minister could not verify the date or location cited, condemned attacks on Orthodox Christians, noted a religious council was asked to investigate, and said Nederland raises protection of vulnerable groups in contacts and EU/UN fora.
The cabinet cannot verify this information.
Het kabinet kan deze informatie niet verifiëren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kahraman over de moordpartijen op orthodoxe christenen in Ethiopië

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about killings of Orthodox Christians in Oromia, Ethiopia, their likely perpetrators (including the OLA), and Dutch steps to monitor, pressure and sanction. The minister confirmed a probable religious dimension but said perpetrators could not be identified, pointed to the Ethiopian interreligious council's inquiry, and largely referred to existing diplomatic channels and sanction criteria without committing to new concrete action.
Listing on the EU Global Human Rights Sanctions list must meet the principles of legal soundness, evidentiary standards and EU unity.
Voor plaatsing op de EU Mensenrechtensanctielijst moet worden voldaan aan de uitgangspunten van juridische soliditeit, bewijsstandaarden en EU-eenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kahraman en Ceder over de kwestie van de Armeense genocide

MPs Ceder and Kahraman asked why the government still refers to 'the question' of the Armenian genocide despite a motion asking it to use the term genocide, and whether fear of Turkish reaction drives the stance. The minister replied that the government keeps the legal Genocide Convention definition, sees positive but precarious developments in the Armenia-Azerbaijan and Armenia-Turkey normalisation, and does not comment on other countries' motives.
As stated in the letter of last April, the cabinet maintains 'the question of the Armenian genocide'.
Zoals in de brief van afgelopen april vermeld staat, houdt het kabinet vast aan «de kwestie van de Armeense genocide».
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kahraman en Ceder over het artikel “Syrische Druzen werden buitengerechtelijk geëxecuteerd’’

MPs Ceder and Kahraman asked the Foreign Minister how the government reacts to reports of extrajudicial executions of Druze in Suwayda, whether the interim Syrian government is responsible, whether sanctions lifting undermines motion Ceder, and how Syria's investigations and accountability efforts are being supported. The minister answered that the government awaits the findings of the Syrian and UN inquiries, supports international accountability mechanisms, and will act with sanctions if the interim government does not deliver.
It is important to establish what exactly happened in Suweida and who was responsible for this violence.
Belangrijk is dat wordt vastgesteld wat er precies is voorgevallen in Suweida en wie verantwoordelijk is geweest voor dit geweld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over 30 doden bij Christenvervolging in Congo

MPs Stoffer and Kahraman asked the Foreign Minister about a July 2025 attack on a Catholic church in Congo's Ituri province that killed over 30 people, including the state's capacity to prevent such attacks, the appointment of an EU religious freedom envoy, aid programmes, and terror listing of the ADF. The minister condemned the violence, described limited state control and EU/Ugandan efforts, said the envoy selection is in its final phase, and declined to comment on ongoing sanctions processes while promising to inform parliament of progress.
The cabinet makes no statements about ongoing sanctions procedures because of their confidentiality.
Het kabinet doet geen uitspraken over lopende sanctietrajecten i.v.m. de vertrouwelijkheid hiervan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kahraman over een tweede streekomroep voor regio Twente

An MP asked the minister whether Twente, with over 600,000 residents, should be split into two regional broadcasting areas after four municipal councils passed a motion to do so, and why a request by five local broadcasters for a separate South-West Twente area was rejected. The minister answered that the NLPO-led process found Twente to be one natural habitat, that the Change Board advised keeping the current division under legal criteria, and that talks with the municipalities and broadcasters will take place in the region.
For Twente, it was concluded on that basis that there is insufficient reason to grant the requested division.
Voor Twente is op grond daarvan geconcludeerd dat er onvoldoende aanleiding is om de gevraagde opdeling te honoreren.
Antwoord op vragen de leden Kahraman en Ceder over de aanval op Druzen in Syrië

MPs Kahraman and Ceder asked the foreign and justice ministers about attacks on Druze in Syria, government responsibility, sanctions, minority protection, Dutch fighters and Syrian-Dutch citizens' safety. The minister answered that responsibility is unclear, pointed to the UN Commission of Inquiry report and EU sanctions options, and said the government will keep monitoring and refer individual cases to existing procedures.
We are following this closely and if follow-up is lacking I will not hesitate to increase pressure on the transitional government, for example through the sanctions instrument.
Wij volgen dit nauwlettend en bij gebrekkige opvolging zal ik niet schromen om de druk op de overgangsregering op te voeren, bijvoorbeeld via het sanctieinstrument.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kahraman over het nieuwsbericht “Enterse Zomp vaart door de ‘Amazone van Twente’, maar dreigt kopje onder te gaan door nieuwe regels”

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether new EU inland navigation qualification rules, which require practical exams, medical checks for those over 70 and administrative duties, threaten volunteer operators of historic boats such as the Enterse Zomp, and whether exemptions or lighter rules could be granted. The minister replied that the Netherlands already applied a lighter, practice-based certificate for excursion boats with a three-year transition period, that the rules are needed for passenger safety, and that no general exemption for heritage vessels is desirable.
My ministry will also continue to support the sector during the transition period to the new boating certificate.
Mijn ministerie zal zich ook in de toekomst blijven inzetten voor het ondersteunen van de sector in de overgangsperiode naar het nieuwe vaarbewijs.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kahraman en Idsinga over het nieuwsbericht 'Brussels approves Poland's use of post-COVID funds for defence'

MPs Kahraman and Idsinga asked the Finance and Foreign Ministers about the Commission's approval of Poland reallocating nearly EUR 6 billion of recovery fund money to defence and whether the Netherlands would seek similar changes. The minister answered that the Dutch plan contains only already-budgeted defence spending, that no contact on reallocating funds to defence has taken place with the Commission, and that remaining payments face implementation risks.
So far, Poland is the only member state that has explicitly added a measure to its original plan allocating funds to defence-related purposes by amending its recovery plan.

Tot op heden is Polen de enige lidstaat die middels een aanpassing van het HVP expliciet een maatregel heeft toegevoegd aan het originele plan om middelen toe te wijzen aan defensie-gerelateerde doeleinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Stoffer, Boswijk en Kahraman over het bericht 'Nigeria: christenen in deelstaat Plateau keer op keer slachtoffer militante Fulani’s.'

MPs from the ChristenUnie, SGP, CDA and Nieuw Sociaal Contract asked the Foreign Minister about reported attacks on Christians in Nigeria's Plateau state by Fulani militants, including the government's response, the role of religion, EU and UN action, and the ECOWAS ruling against Kano blasphemy provisions. The minister answered that the violence stems from local land and resource conflicts, that the government is cautious about framing it by religion, and that it raises the issue bilaterally, in EU and UN settings, and through existing programmes, while committing only to a visit by the Human Rights Ambassador and noting the EU Special Envoy appointment is ongoing.
The cabinet does not know who instigated the violence or what exactly motivated them.
Het is bij het kabinet onbekend wie de aanstichters waren van het geweld en wat hen exact motiveerde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kahraman en Olger van Dijk over verdachte Russische schepen in onze wateren

MPs Kahraman and Olger van Dijk asked the ministers about suspicious Russian ships in Dutch waters, the shadow fleet, espionage around North Sea infrastructure and European sales of tankers to Russia. The government describes sanctions listings, IMO and port-state measures, NATO and regional cooperation, and promises a confidential briefing on the legal analysis of additional powers while declining to detail planned measures.

As promised in the NATO Defence Ministerial committee debate of 5 February 2025, you will be informed through a confidential technical briefing about the outcomes of the legal analysis into additional options to intervene in maritime espionage and sabotage activities.

Zoals toegezegd in het commissiedebat NAVO Defensie Ministeriële op 5 februari 2025, zal u middels een vertrouwelijke technische briefing worden geïnformeerd over de uitkomsten van de juridische analyse
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer, Ceder, Van der Burg, Kahraman, Vermeer, Boswijk en Eerdmans over christenvervolging in de Democratische Republiek Congo

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about the killing of 70 people in a church in the DR Congo, the role of the Special Envoy for Religion, EU terrorist listing of the ADF, foreign support for the ADF, and UN action. The minister condemned the attack, said the Envoy's involvement is not currently of added value, agreed to explore listing the ADF, and described Dutch and EU support for peace and UN human rights mechanisms.
I am willing to examine the possibilities of placing this group on the European terrorism sanctions list or the European ISIS/Al-Qaida sanctions list.
Ik ben bereid te onderzoeken wat de mogelijkheden zijn om deze groep op de Europese terrorisme-sanctielijst of de Europese ISIS/Al-Qaida sanctielijst te plaatsen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kahraman over het vervolgrapport van de Veteranenombudsman

An MP asked the Defence Minister about the Veterans Ombudsman's February 2025 follow-up report on the slow handling of full compensation claims (RVS) and whether earlier recommendations were implemented. The minister acknowledged that the two-year target is missed in 60% of cases, listed steps such as more staff, a new ICT system and clearer communication, and promised a fuller reply and a progress letter by end 2025.
I will inform the House by the end of 2025 about the progress of the various measures in line with the recommendations of the Netherlands Court of Audit and the Veterans Ombudsman.
Ik zal de Kamer eind 2025 informeren over de voortgang van de verschillende maatregelen conform de aanbevelingen van de Algemene Rekenkamer en de Veteranenombudsman.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Stoffer, Kahraman en Boswijk  over de Ranglijst Christenvervolging 2025 van Open Doors

MPs from ChristenUnie, SGP, Nieuw Sociaal Contract and CDA asked the Foreign Minister how the government will respond to the Open Doors 2025 persecution ranking, covering Central Asia, Sub-Saharan Africa, Pakistan, Syria, Algeria and related issues. The minister answered that the government shares the concerns, raises religious freedom bilaterally, in the EU and at the UN, and commits to continued engagement, but declined to support an international UN inquiry into violence in Nigeria as unlikely to win broad support.
The cabinet currently considers it unlikely that there will be broad support for establishing a UN-mandated international commission of inquiry into religious violence in Nigeria.
Het kabinet acht het op dit moment onwaarschijnlijk dat er brede steun zal zijn voor het oprichten van een VN-gemandateerde internationale onderzoekscommissie voor religieus geweld in Nigeria.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Van den Burg, Teunissen, Ceder, Boswijk, Van der Lee en Kahraman over de acuut dreigende uitzetting van Oeigoeren in Thailand

Seven MPs asked the ministers about the imminent deportation of 48 Uyghurs held in Thailand to China and what the Netherlands was doing to prevent it. The Foreign Minister answered that the Netherlands has urged Thailand, bilaterally and within the EU, to respect non-refoulement and not deport the group, and is monitoring third-country resettlement options.
The Netherlands has made the urgent appeal to the Thai authorities, orally and in writing, both bilaterally and within the EU, not to extradite the 48 Uyghurs.

This amount is made up of a fixed fee for the agreed services, an additional amount payable on completion of the transaction, and VAT.

Due to statutory confidentiality obligations for the Tax Authority and De Nederlandsche Bank (DNB), I cannot simply go into the details of this individual case.

Zoals bekend kan ik op grond van artikel 67 van de Algemene Wet inzake Rijksbelastingen geen informatie geven over individuele belastingplichtigen.
Vragen van de leden Omtzigt (CDA), Groot (PvdA) en Braakhuis (GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over de vermogenstoets in de huurtoeslag voor 2012 (ingezonden 23 december 2011).

MPs Omtzigt, Groot and Braakhuis asked whether households with children who exceed the wealth test on 1 January 2012 could lose all their 2012 rent allowance, and why the lowered wealth test was not announced clearly. The state secretary answered that the lowered test applies by law, that the tax authority informed beneficiaries via a press release, a website notice and intermediaries, and that this was considered sufficient outreach.

Furthermore, intermediaries (e.g. housing corporations, social counsellors and municipalities) have been informed about the abolition of the child allowance in the box 3 tax-free allowance, so they can inform their clients.

Verder zijn de intermediairs (o.a. woningbouwcorporaties, sociale raadslieden en gemeenten) geïnformeerd over de afschaffen van de kindertoeslag van het heffingsvrije vermogen in box 3, zodat zij hun klanten hierover kunnen informeren.

Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen (SP), Braakhuis (GroenLinks), Hamer (PvdA) en Van Bemmel (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de falende postbezorging van Post.nl (ingezonden 25

MPs from SP, GroenLinks, PvdA and PVV asked the state secretary about widespread failed and late mail delivery by PostNL shown in a TV broadcast, whether the claimed 96.5% next-day delivery rate is credible, and whether staffing policy is to blame. The state secretary replied that PostNL is responsible for quality, that the 95% overkomstduur norm is measured by an independent bureau and supervised by OPTA, that he sees no reason to revisit the norm, and that staffing is PostNL's own responsibility.
If PostNL does not meet the stated requirements, OPTA can act under the Postal Act.
In het geval PostNL niet aan de gestelde eisen voldoet, kan OPTA op grond van de Postwet optreden.
Vragen van het lid Braakhuis (Groenlinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over belastingontwijking via de deelnemingsvrijstelling (ingezonden 14 oktober 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary of Finance about the Piping Profits report on Dutch holding companies of mining firms, the participation exemption and tax treaties, corporate shareholder transparency (Trafigura's stake in Norilsk Nickel) and whether the exemption applies to such stakes. The state secretary disputes the report's ranking, defends the participation exemption as intended by the legislator, points to existing shareholder disclosure rules under the Wft, and confirms the exemption in principle covers gains on sale unless a non-qualifying low-taxed investment holding applies.
I cannot infer from that that the Netherlands (358) is the largest host country for holdings.
Ik kan daaruit niet afleiden dat Nederland (358) het grootste gastland is voor holdings.
Vragen van het lid Braakhuis (GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over het bericht «Nederland belastingparadijs voor veel multinationals» (ingezonden 18 oktober 2011).

An MP from GroenLinks asked the State Secretary of Finance about reports that many FTSE 100 multinationals, and 1,330 subsidiaries in the Netherlands, use tax havens, and whether the Netherlands should tighten treaties and act on tax avoidance. The State Secretary answered that the study does not define its criteria, that the Netherlands is wrongly labelled a tax haven and meets OECD transparency and substance standards, that no grounds exist to scrutinise those entities or tighten treaties, and that the government supports capacity building in developing countries.
There are no indications that the 1,330 subsidiaries and joint ventures in question do not comply with the law, and I therefore have no reason to 'screen' them.
Er zijn geen aanwijzingen dat de bedoelde 1 330 vennootschappen en joint ventures zich niet aan de wet houden en ik heb dan ook geen reden deze «door te lichten».
Vragen van het lid Braakhuis (GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over artikelen in het FD over belastingontwijking (ingezonden 28 september 2011).

A GroenLinks MP asks the State Secretary of Finance about Financial Dagblad articles on tax avoidance through cooperatives, dividend tax, financing firms and accountant-professor dual roles. The State Secretary answers that cooperatives are generally not subject to dividend withholding tax, that a 2012 anti-abuse measure is proposed, that substance requirements for financing entities are judged adequate, and that dual professorship-accountant roles are permissible under university codes.
However, I do not know how many cooperatives were part of an international structure.
Het is mij echter niet bekend hoeveel coöperaties deel uitmaakten van een internationale structuur.

Vragen van de leden Braakhuis en Sap (beiden GroenLinks) aan de minister-president en de minister van Financiën over het bericht «G20-landen beloven economie te stimuleren» (ingezonden 8 november 2011).

GroenLinks MPs Braakhuis and Sap asked the Prime Minister and Finance Minister about the G20 pledge that surplus countries would stimulate their economies, Nederland's trade surplus and its causes, and whether the government would change its stance on asymmetric adjustment and domestic stimulus. The minister answered that the G20 commitments are conditional and that the government prioritises restoring public finances and competitiveness, while promising to pursue a European growth package within existing fiscal rules.
As you know, the Netherlands was not represented at the G20 summit.
Nederland was zoals u weet niet vertegenwoordigd op de G20 top.

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt (CDA), Neppérus (VVD), Van Vliet (PVV), Koolmees (D66), Braakhuis (GroenLinks) en Schouten (ChristenUnie) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over het rechtstreeks overmaken van kinderopvang

Six MPs from several parties asked the State Secretary of Finance whether childcare allowance should be paid directly to childcare providers to prevent parental arrears, and whether a system with certified payee parties would be designed with stakeholders. The State Secretary said government should in principle not intervene, that a single bank account per taxpayer is planned with an exception for childcare centres under strict conditions, and that the Minister of Social Affairs will consult the sector and report to parliament.

As I indicated at the legislative consultation of 7 November regarding the Tax Package 2012, I will include an exception for childcare centres to the mandatory use of a single bank account via an amendment.

Zoals ik in het wetgevingsoverleg van 7 november jl. over het Belastingpakket 2012 heb aangegeven, zal ik bij nota van wijziging voor kindercentra een uitzondering op het verplicht gebruik van één rekeningnummer opnemen.
Vragen van het lid Braakhuis (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Financiën over het bericht dat de eurocrisis een meevaller van 7,5 miljard euro oplevert (ingezonden 18 oktober 2011).

An MP asks the finance minister whether a reported 7.5 billion euro windfall from the eurozone crisis is credible, how the crisis affects debt sustainability and the cost of bailouts, and how the government communicates risks versus benefits. The minister answers that interest savings are offset by higher debt, that the net effect is higher interest costs since 2007, that the net balance of bailout interventions is currently slightly positive, and that the government holds a signal margin and pursues reforms.
On balance, interest costs on the national debt have increased since 2007.
Per saldo zijn de rentekosten op de staatsschuld sinds 2007 toegenomen.

Vragen van de leden Braakhuis (GroenLinks) en Van Vliet (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over het gebruik van dienstauto’s door managers van de Belastingdienst (ingezonden 12 oktober 2011).

MPs Braakhuis and Van Vliet asked whether Tax Administration managers with homes far from The Hague are entitled to chauffeured company cars for commuting, and about the costs and justification. The state secretary confirmed that nine nationally active managers have chauffeured cars, that use is function-based and periodically reviewed, and that he considers the costs of about 797,000 euros for 2011 justified and will weigh the budget situation in future allocation decisions.
Use of a company car is function-based. Currently this concerns nine managers who have a car with a chauffeur.
Het gebruik van dienstauto is functiegebonden. Het gaat momenteel om negen managers die een auto met chauffeur hebben.

Vragen van het lid Braakhuis (GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over de gebruikelijke werkwijze bij het ontdekken en herstellen van fouten van het personeel bij de Belastingdienst/Toeslagen (ingezonden 23

An MP asked the state secretary how the Tax Administration's Toeslagen (benefits) unit handles staff errors, including whether staff must wait for a client to complain before correcting a wrongly stopped benefit. The state secretary denied that staff must wait, explained that errors found internally are corrected, and that systemic errors are fixed via signals from outside and reported in half-yearly reports.
If the error is discovered by the Tax Administration, it is corrected. The Tax Administration does not wait until the citizen has responded.
Als de fout door de Belastingdienst wordt ontdekt, dan wordt die hersteld. De Belastingdienst wacht daarbij niet totdat de burger heeft gereageerd.

Vragen van het lid Braakhuis (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Financiën over het bericht dat de heer Zalm de jaarrekening van DSB bewust te laat uitbracht en daarmee spaarders heeft misleid (ingezonden 17 juni 2011).

An MP asks the Finance Minister whether late filing of DSB's annual accounts, allegedly deliberate and misleading savers, was examined by AFM and DNB, what sanctions apply, and whether ABN Amro's Zalm's position is affected. The minister confirms AFM and DNB considered the filing in their investigations of former DSB directors, cites confidentiality limits, notes possible criminal, administrative and civil liability, and says no reason to doubt sanctions' adequacy.
Any additional information about these investigations I unfortunately cannot give, because it is governed by the confidentiality regime of the Financial Supervision Act.
Eventuele aanvullende informatie over deze onderzoeken kan ik u helaas niet geven omdat deze wordt beheerst door het regime van vertrouwelijkheid uit de Wet op het financieel toezicht.

Vragen van de leden Van Gent en Braakhuis (beiden GroenLinks) aan de minister-president en de minister van Financiën over het artikel «Rutte & De Jager niet de slimsten van Europa: Finland heeft bij de Grieken een onderp

The MPs ask whether the Finance Minister knew at the 21 July 2011 Eurosummit that individual states could negotiate bilateral collateral deals with Greece, why the Chamber was not informed, and how the government will avoid unequal treatment. The minister answers that the summit conclusions allowed a collateral arrangement only at euro-area level, not bilaterally, that Finland and Greece acknowledged this, and that the Chamber was informed at several moments.
As I stated in the letter of 22 August (reference BFB 2011-1666M), the Chamber was informed at various moments about the discussions on collateral.
Zoals ik aangaf in de brief van 22 augustus jl. (kenmerk BFB 2011-1666M) is de Kamer op verschillende momenten geïnformeerd over de discussies rond onderpand.

Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen (SP), Hamer (PvdA) en Braakhuis (Groenlinks) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het UWV dat weiger

MPs from SP, PvdA and GroenLinks asked why UWV refused PostNL dismissal permits for sorting staff and how the dismissal rules were applied, including the shift from permanent to flexible work and a motion on UWV's work instruction. The minister answered that permits were refused because the selection did not follow the afspiegelingsbeginsel and because it was unclear whether temporary and agency staff would continue, and that the work instruction did not play a role in this assessment.
In this case the permits were refused because the dismissal selection was not in line with the afspiegelingsbeginsel.
In dit geval zijn de vergunningen geweigerd omdat de ontslagkeuze niet in overeenstemming was met het afspiegelingsbeginsel.

Vragen van de leden Voordewind, Ortega-Martijn (beiden ChristenUnie) en Braakhuis (GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over mensenrechten

MPs Voordewind, Ortega-Martijn and Braakhuis asked the state secretaries about labour and environmental abuses in electronics supply chains (Foxconn/Apple), transparency laws, and government procurement safeguards. The government condemned the abuses, pointed to OECD guidelines, industry initiatives and procurement criteria, but declined a Dutch supply chain transparency law as disproportionate and costly.
Vragen van de leden El Fassed en Braakhuis (beiden GroenLinks) aan de ministers van Financiën en van Buitenlandse Zaken over de huisbankier RBS en clustermunitie (ingezonden 27 mei 2011).

MPs El Fassed and Braakhuis asked the Finance and Foreign Affairs ministers about state bank RBS's alleged investments in cluster munitions producers, RBS's assurances, state-supported institutions' services, and the selection criteria for the state's bank. The minister said RBS disputes the report's claims, that the government is reviewing how to respond to a Senate motion on banning such investments, and that it will inform the Senate in writing.
We cannot confirm the claim in the press release, because we are not in a position to establish the accuracy of the press release and the report.
Wij kunnen de stelling in het persbericht niet bevestigen, omdat wij niet in de gelegenheid zijn de juistheid van het bericht en het rapport vast te stellen.
Vragen van het lid Braakhuis (GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over openbaarmaking van rulings (ingezonden 21 april 2011).

An MP asks the State Secretary for Finance about the 2009 publication of 22 documents on tax rulings, whether confidentiality (Awr, Wob) allows fuller disclosure, and whether anonymised rulings of the 50 largest companies can be provided. The State Secretary says the documents were anonymised cooperation agreements not rulings, that tax confidentiality takes precedence over the Wob, that anonymisation of the requested data would be infeasible, and offers a technical briefing.
Adequate anonymisation is otherwise not possible, because insiders can deduce from the circumstances of the case which taxpayer is concerned.
Afdoende anonimisering is anders niet mogelijk, doordat ingewijde derden uit de omstandigheden van het geval kunnen afleiden om welke belastingplichtige het gaat.

Vragen van het lid Braakhuis (GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over het door DNB verstrekte getal van 12,3 biljoen euro dat in totaal jaarlijks door Nederland instroomt en uitstroomt (ingezonden 21 april

An MP asks the state secretary of Finance about DNB figures showing about 12.3 trillion euros flowing through the Netherlands yearly via special financial institutions, requesting breakdowns by offshore centre, company type, royalty income, tax paid, and international action on shell companies. The state secretary provides a 2009 breakdown by country, explains that finer detail is withheld for confidentiality, estimates the economic value of the hub, defends the innovation box, and declines to pursue an international study of such flows.
More detail cannot be provided due to confidentiality and the possible traceability to individual data.
Meer detail kan in verband met de vertrouwelijkheid en de mogelijke herleidbaarheid naar individuele gegevens niet worden verschaft.

Vragen van het lid Braakhuis (GroenLinks) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het aantrekken van foute ondernemers naar aanleiding van het bericht «Britse BV-v

An MP asks ministers whether foreign limited companies (Ltd's) are being used to evade Dutch startup requirements and commit bankruptcy fraud, and what will be done. The ministers answer that EU freedom of establishment obliges recognition of such companies, that UK directors face strict liability, that no data shows Ltd's are more fraud-prone than Dutch BVs, and that a planned BV reform and a university chair on bankruptcy fraud are the responses.
Specific information on the extent of bankruptcy fraud using the limited as a legal form, and the resulting damage, is not known.
Over de omvang van faillissementsfraude waarbij de limited als rechtsvorm gebruikt wordt en de eventueel daaruit voortvloeiende schade, is geen specifieke informatie bekend.

Vragen van de leden Klaver en Braakhuis (beiden GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over het bericht van de ombudsman dat de Belastingdienst 6 miljoen euro ten onrechte niet uitbetaalt aan buitenlandse pens

MPs Klaver and Braakhuis asked the state secretary of Finance about the ombudsman's report that the Tax Authority wrongly withholds 6 million euros from foreign pensioners, and how the Tax Authority can decide itself whether to apply a law. The state secretary said the Tax Authority refunds amounts on its own initiative, that for 2010 it will use file matching, and that since 2006-2009 claimants must request refunds, with CVZ referring complaints and websites updated, plus talks with CVZ about a mailing.
Every government organisation is obliged to respect the rights of citizens.
Elke overheidsorganisatie is gehouden om de rechten van burgers te respecteren.

Vragen van het lid Braakhuis (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het bericht dat supermarkten, winkels en particulieren in de binnenstad van Amsterdam maar één alcoholische cons

An MP asked the minister whether a per-customer limit of one alcoholic drink on Koninginnedag 2011 in central Amsterdam would be effective, proportionate and manageable for shops and bars, and whether the minister would talk to the mayor. The minister, answering on behalf of the government, said public order is the municipality's responsibility, that the mayor's rules were supported by the hospitality sector, and that no intervention was warranted at this stage.
Safeguarding public order is a responsibility of the municipal government and of the mayor in particular.
Het waarborgen van de openbare orde is een verantwoordelijkheid van het gemeentebestuur en van de burgemeester in het bijzonder.
Vragen van het lid Braakhuis (GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over de Belastingdienst (ingezonden 31 maart 2011).

The MP asks the state secretary of Finance about the Belastingdienst: whether late-filing fines were quadrupled, whether citizens are adequately informed, payment arrangements, the fictitious 4% return on savings, electronic filing with older computers and DigiD delays, and whether pre-filled returns cause missed deductions. The secretary replies that the maximum fine was already raised in 2010, that information channels are adequate, that existing payment and exemption rules suffice, that the forfeit return reflects broader asset returns, and that older operating systems and DigiD timing are citizens' responsibility, with no special regime planned.
In view of the foregoing, I see no reason to impose the fines with leniency.
Gezien het voorgaande zie ik geen aanleiding de boeteoplegging met de nodige coulance op te leggen.
Vragen van het lid Braakhuis (GroenLinks) aan de minister en de staatssecretaris van Financiën over de onhoudbaarheid van de hypotheekaftrek (ingezonden 1 april 2011).

An MP asks the Finance Minister whether the government will address the mortgage interest deduction after the IMF and DNB called for reform, and why the government does not accept their arguments. The minister answers that the housing market is currently stable, the government's position is known, and the market needs calm rather than a renewed debate, referring to a separate letter on mortgage lending norms.
The housing market now needs calm, not a renewed discussion of the arguments for and against the mortgage interest deduction.
De woningmarkt heeft nu behoefte aan rust, niet aan een herhaalde discussie over de argumenten voor en tegen de hypotheekrenteaftrek.
Vragen van het lid Braakhuis (GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over belastingontwijkroutes die worden gebruikt door Kadhafi in Nederland (ingezonden 25 februari 2011).

An MP from GroenLinks asked the State Secretary of Finance whether Dutch tax authorities make special deals with multinationals and foreign firms, and how Gaddafi-linked tax avoidance routes operate, along with questions on sanctions and the Tax Authority's moral responsibility. The State Secretary answered that all firms face the same laws, that agreements are made only within legal frameworks, and that suspected misconduct would be reported to prosecutors and supervisory bodies, while describing EU sanctions freezing Libyan state entities' assets.

Should the Tax Authority, for example when assessing returns or in a possible audit, encounter the irregularities referred to in the question, it will report them to other government and supervisory bodies.

Mocht de Belastingdienst, bijvoorbeeld bij het vaststellen van de aangifte of een eventueel boekenonderzoek, stuiten op de in de vraag bedoelde onregelmatigheden, dan zal de Belastingdienst deze melden bij andere overheids- en toezichtsinstanties

Vragen van het lid Braakhuis (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Financiën over het alternatieve voorstel van de Nederlandse Vereniging van Banken en de verzekeraars voor tophypotheken (ingezonden 8 februari 2011).

MP Braakhuis asks the Finance Minister about the banks' and insurers' alternative mortgage proposal, which they argued justified delaying tighter rules, and whether NHG repayment norms are an adequate substitute, and whether the delay caused unnecessary forced sales. The minister replies that the sector's new Gedragscode offers comparable consumer protection, that banks cap interest-only lending at 50% of market value, and that no link to forced sales is known.

I am, after consultation with the Authority for the Financial Markets, of the view that this new code of conduct offers a comparable level of consumer protection as the decree on the mortgage lending assessment framework.

Ik ben, mede na onderhoud met de Autoriteit Financiële Markten, van mening dat deze nieuwe gedragscode een vergelijkbaar niveau van consumentenbescherming biedt als het besluit toetskader hypothecaire kredietverlening.
Vragen van het lid Braakhuis (GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over Buma/Stemra (ingezonden 18 februari 2011).

An MP asks the State Secretary about the composition of the Buma/Stemra board, whether music publishers dominate it, the powers of the College van Toezicht, independent investigation, the monopoly position, and reporting detail. The State Secretary replies that the board split is not unbalanced, that the College will get new powers and publishing duties, and that further steps will follow in a forthcoming copyright letter.

The bill also provides a legal basis for a general administrative order on the organisation and governance of a CBO and on the level and form of remuneration of directors, the supervisory board and those who handle day-to-day management.

Het wetsvoorstel voorziet daarnaast in een grondslag voor het opstellen van een algemene maatregel van bestuur inzake de inrichting en het bestuur van een cbo en over de hoogte en de vorm van de bezoldiging van bestuurders, de raad van toezicht en degene die zich met de dagelijkse leiding bezig houden.
Vragen van het lid Braakhuis (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Financiën over autokredieten (ingezonden 18 februari 2011).

Braakhuis asked the Finance Minister how he views car dealers acting as credit intermediaries, whether conduct supervision and commission transparency apply to consumer credit, and whether 'borrowing costs money' warnings in car-financing ads are effective. The minister replied that dealers fall under AFM conduct supervision with past enforcement, that consumer credit is excluded from the commission ban for now, and that he will investigate whether additional measures such as transparency rules are needed.
I therefore consider it important to closely monitor market developments and will investigate whether additional measures are needed for consumer credit.
Ik vind het daarom van belang om de marktontwikkelingen goed te volgen en zal onderzoeken of bij consumptief krediet aanvullende maatregelen nodig zijn.
Vragen van het lid Braakhuis (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Financiën over de onevenwichtige gezamenlijke lobby van Financiën en verzekeraars in Brussel (ingezonden 7 maart 2011).

Braakhuis (GroenLinks) asked the Finance Minister whether Finance's joint lobbying with insurers, intermediaries and asset managers toward the European Commission on packaged retail investment products was balanced given consumer protection goals. Minister De Jager answered that it was a single joint written consultation response, that the initial line was set after broad consultation including the Consumentenbond, and that consumer organisations are routinely consulted.
There is no question of a joint lobby; it concerns a written consultation response in which several parties can find themselves.
Van een gezamenlijke lobby is geen sprake, het betreft een schriftelijke consultatiereactie waarin meerdere partijen zich kunnen vinden.
Vragen van het lid Braakhuis (GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over belastingontwijkroutes (ingezonden 14 januari 2011).

An MP from GroenLinks asks the state secretary of Finance about tax avoidance routes, including the scale of financial flows through Dutch entities, their employment effects, whether companies are held accountable, and royalty payments in the SAB-Miller case. The state secretary answers that the large figure is not a taxable-profit measure, that existing transfer pricing and anti-abuse rules suffice, that confidentiality prevents naming companies, and that no further legislation on royalties is planned.
No, because of the duty of confidentiality I cannot name concrete examples of companies where these themes were discussed in consultations between the Tax Administration and companies.

Nee, omwille van de geheimhoudingsverplichting kan ik geen concrete voorbeelden van bedrijven noemen waarbij deze thema's aan de orde zijn geweest in het overleg tussen de Belastingdienst en bedrijven.
Vragen van de leden Koolmees (D66) en Braakhuis (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Financiën over de bankiersverklaring (ingezonden 24 januari 2011).

MPs Koolmees and Braakhuis asked whether the banker's oath is a token gesture, why DNB did not take a coordinating role, and whether it should be formalised and enforced as a condition for approval of bank directors. The minister acknowledged the oath's importance, noted it is embedded in the legally anchored Code Banken, and committed to consulting the NVB, DNB and AFM on giving it a more formal status, including possible linkage to DNB suitability checks.
In light of this, I will consult with the Dutch Banking Association, DNB and the AFM on giving the moral-ethical declaration a more formal status.

Mede gelet hierop zal ik met de Nederlandse Vereniging van Banken (hierna: de NVB), DNB en de Autoriteit Financiële Markten (hierna: de AFM) in overleg treden over een meer formele status van de moreel-ethische verklaring.

Vragen van de leden Klaver en Braakhuis (beiden GroenLinks) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en de staatssecretaris van Financiën over pensioenregelingen (ingezonden 8 februari 2011).

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the ministers whether pension insurers' administrative errors reported by DNB, and the complexity of pension schemes, are unacceptable, and whether the government will push for simplification in the pension negotiations and reduce administrative costs for small firms. The minister acknowledged the errors, supported DNB's request for an action plan, said simplification is for social partners to propose, and pointed to ongoing ministry consultations on wider use of the policy administration to reduce burdens.
I endorse the request DNB made to insurers to draw up an action plan setting out how the shortcomings will be corrected in the short term.
Ik onderschrijf het verzoek dat DNB heeft gedaan aan verzekeraars een plan van aanpak op te stellen waarin wordt aangegeven hoe op korte termijn de onvolkomenheden worden gecorrigeerd.
Vragen van het lid Braakhuis (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Financiën over het bankproduct «Turks Fruit Deposito» (ingezonden 16 december 2010).

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether the Garanti Bank 'Turks Fruit Deposito' misleadingly presents as a regular savings product, whether deposit guarantee should cover currency risk, and what supervisory oversight applies. The minister answered that it is a foreign-currency deposit under Dutch supervision, that the AFM oversees information provision and DNB oversees deposit guarantee coverage, and that exchange-rate risk is not covered by the guarantee.
The AFM is responsible for supervising the provision of information about financial products, including information on the website.
De AFM is verantwoordelijk voor het toezicht op de informatieverstrekking over financiële producten, waaronder informatieverstrekking op de website.
Vragen van het lid Braakhuis aan de minister van Financiën over betalingsverkeer via internet (ingezonden 8 december 2010).

MP Braakhuis asked the Finance Minister about reports that ING customers' basic data could be retrieved online and whether DNB allowing payment by mandate without signature enables fraud, asking about risks of online payment methods and guarantees for customers and webshops. The minister answered that a one-off direct debit requires a signed written mandate, that other online payment methods carry no substantially new risks, that overlay services may need regulation at EU level, and that he cannot guarantee no one will fall victim to fraud.
If it turns out that regulation is ultimately needed to guarantee the security of payment traffic at a sufficient level, I will not fail to do so.
Mocht het zo zijn dat uiteindelijk regelgeving nodig is om de veiligheid van het betalingsverkeer op een voldoende niveau te kunnen waarborgen, dan zal ik dat niet nalaten.

Vragen van het lid Braakhuis (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de brief van KPN over de opzegtermijn bij zakelijke contracten (ingezonden 13 december 2010).

An MP asked the minister about KPN's November letter to business customers that unclearly set a one-year contract default if they did not respond, and about the raised standard notice period; the minister said OPTA supervises compliance with the Telecommunications Act, that enforcement requests are pending, and that SME protection is limited by EU rules, with a Bill to add a passive information duty for SMEs.
OPTA has these enforcement requests under consideration; OPTA's investigation is still ongoing.
OPTA heeft deze handhavingsverzoeken in behandeling; het onderzoek van OPTA loopt nog.
Vragen van het lid Braakhuis (GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over het bericht «Concerns ontwijken Afrikaanse fiscus» (ingezonden 2 december 2010).

An MP from GroenLinks asks the State Secretary of Finance whether Dutch tax rules let multinationals shift profits out of developing countries through royalties and conduit companies, and requests an audit of the Dutch fiscal system as earlier motions asked. The State Secretary replies that Dutch rules are part of an international network, that unilateral Dutch measures would have limited effect and could harm the real economy, and that OECD and G20 initiatives plus capacity building in developing countries are the preferred route.
Vragen van de leden Braakhuis en Sap (beiden GroenLinks) aan de minister van Financiën over maatregelen met betrekking tot tophypotheken (ingezonden 2 december 2010).

Two MPs from GroenLinks asked the Finance Minister why the banks were given until 1 February 2011 to self-regulate mortgage lending limits, whether the AFM was involved, and whether self-regulation would be enforced given past breaches. The minister replied that a draft general administrative order (AMvB) tightening mortgage norms has been sent to the Council of State, while the Dutch banking association may offer a revised code by 1 February that the minister will assess before deciding whether self-regulation with AFM supervision suffices.
I will involve the House of Representatives in this consideration.
Ik zal de Tweede Kamer betrekken in deze overweging.
Vragen van het lid Braakhuis (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over kinderarbeid bij de hazelnotenpluk in Turkije (ingezonden 21 oktober 2010).

An MP asks the government about child labour in Turkish hazelnut picking, citing reports of large numbers of school-age children working, the number of Dutch firms trading Turkish hazelnuts, consumer origin labelling, initiatives within the supply chain and at EU level. The government refers back to its joint answers to earlier questions and gives a non-specific reply, noting no official figures exist and that it has not yet set concrete new measures.
No official figures are known on this.
Hierover zijn geen officiële cijfers bekend.

Vragen van het lid Braakhuis (GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het rapport «De Weet wat je eet Gifmeter Bestrijdin

An MP from GroenLinks asked the ministers about the nVWA's 2009 pesticide residue findings on fruit and vegetables, including the risk-based inspection approach, Dutch produce exceeding limits more than imports, and whether the EU limits should follow WHO hazard classifications. The government defended the risk-based approach, said the nVWA audit found no shortcomings, rejected a ban on WHO-classified substances, and noted that the results are published online.
The nVWA's supervision is risk-based, meaning it mainly samples and inspects where exceedances can be expected.
Het toezicht van nVWA is op risico gebaseerd. Dat komt er op neer dat de nVWA vooral daar bemonstert en controleert waar overschrijdingen kunnen worden verwacht.

Vragen van de leden Dibi en Braakhuis (beiden GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretarisvan Buitenlandse Zaken en de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de arrestatie van een journalist (ingezonden 9 november 2010).

Two GroenLinks MPs asked whether the arrest of a journalist at Brussels North station for photographing a police action against asylum seekers, later dropped, violated press freedom, and whether the Netherlands could change EU law on newsgathering. The government answered that the arrest is a Belgian internal matter, that the EU Charter already guarantees freedom of expression, and that the EU lacks competence to regulate press freedom in member states.
This concerns an internal Belgian matter that must therefore be assessed by the Belgian authorities.
Het betreft hier een interne Belgische aangelegenheid die dan ook door de Belgische autoriteiten moet worden beoordeeld.

Vragen van de leden Ortega-Martijn en Voordewind (beiden ChristenUnie), Dikkers (PvdA), Braakhuis (GroenLinks) en Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister van Economische Zaken over uitbuiting door toeleveranciers van C&A en H&M

MPs from several parties asked the Economic Affairs minister about labour exploitation at Indian suppliers of C&A and H&M, including KPR Mills, its SA8000 certification, and government risk lists. The government answered that the companies have tried to influence the supplier, that it does not subsidise or supervise them, and that it will continue dialogue with the sector and the Indian government without committing to new binding measures.
We see no role for the government in this.
Wij zien hierbij geen rol voor de overheid.

Vragen van het lid Verhoeven (D66), Schaart (VVD) en Braakhuis (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de ontstane onduidelijkheid over het afronden op hele belminuten door telecoma

MPs Verhoeven, Schaart and Braakhuis asked the minister about telecom providers rounding call charges up to whole minutes, and whether EU rules and national consumer choice permit this. The minister answered that EU roaming rules do not cover domestic calls, that member states may regulate billing proportionately, and that KPN and Vodafone pledged more per-second options and transparency by early 2011.
I want to give the market the chance to improve these points. I want the commitments made to be fulfilled early in 2011.
Ik wil de markt de kans geven deze punten te verbeteren. Ik wil dat de gedane toezeggingen begin 2011 ingevuld zijn.

Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen (SP), Ortega-Martijn (ChristenUnie), Braakhuis (GroenLinks), Dikkers (PvdA) en Veldhoven-Van der Meer (D66) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Economische Zaken over de probleme

Five MPs asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Economic Affairs about Shell's oil extraction problems in Nigeria, following a Zembla broadcast and an Amnesty International report, and whether the Dutch government will intensify its efforts and respond to a UNEP-related case. The ministers answered that Nederland supports EITI transparency, a human rights fund, and dialogue with Shell and the Nigerian government, will intensify efforts where needed, will contact UNEP's Ogoniland program head, and will await UNEP's report before drawing conclusions.
Where necessary, these efforts will be further intensified.
Waar nodig zullen deze inspanningen verder worden geïntensiveerd.
Vragen van het lid Braakhuis (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Economische Zaken over het artikel «Verlaag het tarief voor analoge kabeltelevisie» (ingezonden 25 augustus 2010).

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs whether OPTA's underspending on its core task of competition promotion, and its court-annulled cable decisions, reflect poorly on the regulator and whether cable operators' network monopoly should be broken. The minister replies that OPTA's overall cuts were balanced, that the underspend was offset by higher market-analysis spending, that OPTA is effective and ranked first in Europe, and that market definition and market power are for the independent regulator to decide.
I want to emphasise first of all that I have no reason to doubt the effectiveness of OPTA's functioning.
Ik wil in de eerste plaats benadrukken dat ik geen aanleiding heb om te twijfelen aan de doeltreffendheid van het functioneren van OPTA.
Vragen van het lid Braakhuis (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Financiën over de mogelijkheid voor het introduceren van een EU-belasting (ingezonden 12 augustus 2010).

An MP asks the Finance Minister whether he supports an EU-level tax on aviation and/or financial transactions, offset by lower national EU contributions, and how a demissionary cabinet would handle such proposals in the EU budget review. The minister answers that taxation is a member-state competence, that the Netherlands prefers the GNI-based own resource as sole EU financing source, that a financial transaction tax would fail to stabilise markets, and that the issue will be left to a future cabinet.
First of all, I would point out that taxation is a competence of the member states and the Treaty provides no autonomous taxing power for the EU.
Allereerst wil ik er op wijzen dat belastingheffing een bevoegdheid van de lidstaten is en het Verdrag geen autonome heffingsbevoegdheid voor de EU kent.
Vragen van het lid Braakhuis (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Economische Zaken over het vertrek van MSD (ingezonden 9 juli 2010).

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs how the government responds to MSD's withdrawal of much of its Oss operations, whether it knew of the plans, what causes lie behind the departure, and what it will do to retain knowledge-intensive jobs and support affected workers. The minister regrets the cuts, reports intensified contacts with MSD and working groups to retain jobs and knowledge, cites the company's own complaints about R&D funding and regulation, and promises to deploy job-placement instruments while stating that the decision was driven mainly by group-level strategy.
The cabinet realises that the plans hit the affected employees hard.
Het kabinet beseft dat de plannen voor de getroffen medewerkers hard aankomen.

Vragen van het lid Braakhuis (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Economische Zaken over de berichtgeving dat de Rabobank weigert een rekening te openen voor Vakwerk, de vakbond voor prostituees (ingezonden 8 juli 2010).

Green Left MP Braakhuis asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether she accepts that Rabobank refused a bank account to Vakwerk, the sex workers' union, and what steps will address the resulting unequal treatment in banking. The minister replied that access to primary payment services is essential, that categorical exclusion without individual assessment is undesirable, and that the Dutch banking association agreed to assess applications individually, though incidents may still occur.
A solution in which banks voluntarily accept clients, in compliance with customer due diligence rules, is preferred.
Een oplossing waarbij banken cliënten vrijwillig accepteren – met inachtneming van de regelgeving op het gebied van customer due diligence – heeft de voorkeur.
Vragen van het lid Braakhuis (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Economische Zaken over het instellen van een «Geen gezeur aan mijn deur register» (ingezonden 8 juli 2010).

MP Braakhuis asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether she would introduce a 'do not ring the bell' register for door-to-door sales after a survey showed 62.6% of Dutch citizens support one, and why a 'do not call' register is easier to enforce. The minister rejected a statutory register, citing legitimate door-to-door selling, EU Services Directive concerns, harm to local charities, and enforcement difficulties, instead pointing to consumer education, the Deurwijzer, and tougher enforcement powers and higher fines.
I am not in favour of a statutory 'do not ring the bell' register.
Ik ben geen voorstander van een wettelijk Bel-niet-aan-register.
